prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Wavefront — Indie-First Music Streaming</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <meta name="description" content="Wavefront is a modern music streaming app focused on indie artists. Discover new sounds, support creators, and listen without limits." />
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #060013;
      --bg-alt: #120726;
      --bg-elevated: #1a1033;
      --accent: #1ee3cf;
      --accent-soft: #17b8a8;
      --accent-alt: #a86cf2;
      --text-main: #f7f4ff;
      --text-muted: #b7afd6;
      --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      --shadow-soft: 0 24px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      --radius-lg: 18px;
      --radius-full: 999px;
      --transition-fast: 180ms ease-out;
      --font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text",
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, #26104a 0, var(--bg) 55%);
      color: var(--text-main);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .page {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1120px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 20px;
    }

    /* Header / Nav */
    header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 40;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6, 0, 19, 0.96), rgba(6, 0, 19, 0.82), transparent);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 16px 0 10px;
    }

    .nav-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .logo-mark {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: conic-gradient(from 160deg, #1ee3cf, #a86cf2, #1ee3cf);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .logo-mark::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 5px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.26), transparent 55%),
                  radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), transparent 60%);
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
    }

    .logo-text {
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      font-size: 15px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 22px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .nav-links a {
      padding: 4px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-links a::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      bottom: -4px;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent), var(--accent-alt));
      transition: width var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .nav-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .nav-ghost {
      padding: 7px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: rgba(13, 1, 34, 0.5);
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-ghost:hover {
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
      color: var(--text-main);
      background: rgba(24, 7, 52, 0.8);
    }

    .nav-cta {
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-alt));
      color: #05000b;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(23, 184, 168, 0.45);
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), filter var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-cta span {
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .nav-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      filter: brightness(1.04);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(23, 184, 168, 0.6);
    }

    /* Hero */
    main {
      flex: 1;
    }

    .hero {
      padding: 60px 0 64px;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 56px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-kicker {
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .hero-kicker-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(30, 227, 207, 0.9);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      line-height: 1.08;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .hero-title span {
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-alt));

question: website-landing-page
prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Wavefront — Discover Indie Music</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --purple-deep: #1a0a2e;
            --purple-mid: #2d1b69;
            --purple-light: #7b2fbe;
            --purple-glow: #a855f7;
            --teal-deep: #0d3b3e;
            --teal-mid: #0f766e;
            --teal-light: #14b8a6;
            --teal-glow: #5eead4;
            --white: #f8fafc;
            --gray-light: #cbd5e1;
            --gray-mid: #94a3b8;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--purple-deep);
            color: var(--white);
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* Navbar */
        nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 1.25rem 2rem;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            background: rgba(26, 10, 46, 0.7);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.1);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        nav.scrolled {
            background: rgba(26, 10, 46, 0.95);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.3);
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-light), var(--teal-light));
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .nav-btn {
            padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            border: none;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-outline {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--white);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        }

        .btn-outline:hover {
            border-color: var(--teal-light);
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        .hamburger {
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            padding: 5px;
        }

        .hamburger span {
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--white);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            padding: 8rem 2rem 4rem;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-bg .orb {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(80px);
            opacity: 0.4;
            animation: float 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .orb-1 {
            width: 500px;
            height: 500px;
            background: var(--purple-light);
            top: -10%;
            right: -5%;
            animation-delay: 0s !important;
        }

        .orb-2 {
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: var(--teal-mid);
            bottom: -10%;
            left: -5%;
            animation-delay: -3s !important;
        }

        .orb-3 {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: var(--purple-glow);
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            opacity: 0.15;
            animation-delay: -5s !important;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-30px) scale(1.05); }
        }

        .grid-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image: 
                linear-gradient(rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 800px;
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.3);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--purple-glow);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out;
        }

        .badge-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.1s both;
        }

        .hero h1 .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light), var(--purple-glow), var(--teal-glow));
            background-size: 200% 200%;
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            animation: gradientShift 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes gradientShift {
            0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            line-height: 1.7;
            max-width: 560px;
            margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.2s both;
        }

        .hero-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.3s both;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            border: none;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-light), var(--teal-mid));
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn-primary::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-light));
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.3);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .btn-primary span {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .play-icon {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .hero-stats {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 3rem;
            margin-top: 4rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.4s both;
        }

        .stat {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-size: 1.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            margin-top: 0.25rem;
        }

        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(30px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        /* Player Preview */
        .player-section {
            padding: 2rem 2rem 6rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .player-preview {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(45, 27, 105, 0.5), rgba(13, 59, 62, 0.3));
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.2);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 2rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out;
        }

        .player-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .player-title {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .player-dots {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .player-dots span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        }

        .player-dots span:first-child { background: var(--purple-glow); }
        .player-dots span:nth-child(2) { background: var(--teal-light); }

        .track-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .track {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .track:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .track.active {
            background: rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.2);
        }

        .track-art {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .track-info {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .track-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
        }

        .track-artist {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
        }

        .track-duration {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .track-eq {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 2px;
            height: 20px;
        }

        .track-eq span {
            width: 3px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            border-radius: 2px;
            animation: eq 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .track-eq span:nth-child(1) { height: 40%; animation-delay: 0s; }
        .track-eq span:nth-child(2) { height: 70%; animation-delay: 0.15s; }
        .track-eq span:nth-child(3) { height: 50%; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .track-eq span:nth-child(4) { height: 90%; animation-delay: 0.1s; }

        @keyframes eq {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
            50% { transform: scaleY(0.4); }
        }

        .waveform {
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .wave-time {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            font-weight: 500;
            min-width: 35px;
        }

        .wave-bars {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2px;
            height: 40px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .wave-bar {
            flex: 1;
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .wave-bar.played {
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--teal-light), var(--purple-glow));
        }

        .wave-bar.unplayed {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* Features Section */
        .features {
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 4rem;
        }

        .section-tag {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--teal-light);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-header p {
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1.5rem;
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(45, 27, 105, 0.3), rgba(13, 59, 62, 0.15));
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.1);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .feature-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--purple-glow), var(--teal-light), transparent);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            border-color: rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.3);
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(45, 27, 105, 0.5), rgba(13, 59, 62, 0.25));
        }

        .feature-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .feature-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .feature-icon.purple {
            background: rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.2);
        }

        .feature-icon.teal {
            background: rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.2);
        }

        .feature-icon.mixed {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.15), rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.15));
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.15);
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* How It Works */
        .how-it-works {
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .steps {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 2rem;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            position: relative;
        }

        .steps::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 44px;
            left: 15%;
            right: 15%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple-light), var(--teal-mid));
            opacity: 0.3;
        }

        .step {
            text-align: center;
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
        }

        .step-number {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .step:nth-child(1) .step-number {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-mid), var(--purple-light));
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.3);
        }

        .step:nth-child(2) .step-number {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-light), var(--teal-mid));
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.2);
        }

        .step:nth-child(3) .step-number {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-light));
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.3);
        }

        .step h3 {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .step p {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
            line-height: 1.6;
            max-width: 250px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        /* Testimonials */
        .testimonials {
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
        }

        .testimonials-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1.5rem;
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .testimonial-card {
            background: rgba(45, 27, 105, 0.2);
            border: 1px solid rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.1);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2rem;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .testimonial-card:hover {
            border-color: rgba(123, 47, 190, 0.25);
        }

        .stars {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            color: #fbbf24;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .testimonial-text {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--gray-light);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .testimonial-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .author-avatar {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        .author-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .author-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .author-role {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--gray-mid);
        }

        /* CTA Section */
        .cta {
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

    <script>
        // Generate waveform bars
        const waveformContainer = document.getElementById('waveform');
        const totalBars = 80;
        const playedPercentage = 0.38;

        for (let i = 0; i < totalBars; i++) {
            const bar = document.createElement('div');
            bar.classList.add('wave-bar');
            bar.classList.add(i / totalBars < playedPercentage ? 'played' : 'unplayed');
            
            // Create natural-looking waveform heights
            const base = 0.3;
            const variation = Math.sin(i * 0.3) * 0.3 + Math.sin(i * 0.7) * 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3;
            const height = Math.max(base, Math.min(1, base + variation));
            bar.style.height = `${height * 100}%`;
            
            waveformContainer.appendChild(bar);
        }

        // Navbar scroll effect
        const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 50) {
                navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
            } else {
                navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
            }
        });

        // Scroll reveal animations
        const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }
            });
        }, {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        });

        revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

        // Mobile nav toggle
        function toggleMobileNav() {
            const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
            mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
            document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
        }

        // Form submission
        function handleSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const email = document.getElementById('emailInput');
            const btn = e.target.querySelector('.btn-primary span');
            
            btn.textContent = '✓ You\'re on the list!';
            email.value = '';
            email.disabled = true;
            e.target.querySelector('.btn-primary').disabled = true;
            e.target.querySelector('.btn-primary').style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0f766e, #14b8a6)';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.textContent = 'Get Early Access';
                email.disabled = false;
                e.target.querySelector('.btn-primary').disabled = false;
                e.target.querySelector('.btn-primary').style.background = '';
            }, 3000);
        }

        // Waveform click interaction
        waveformContainer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const rect = waveformContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
            const clickPosition = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
            const bars = waveformContainer.querySelectorAll('.wave-bar');
            
            bars.forEach((bar, i) => {
                const barPosition = i / bars.length;
                bar.classList.remove('played', 'unplayed');
                bar.classList.add(barPosition < clickPosition ? 'played' : 'unplayed');
            });

            // Update time display
            const totalSeconds = 222; // 3:42
            const currentSeconds = Math.floor(totalSeconds * clickPosition);
            const minutes = Math.floor(currentSeconds / 60);
            const seconds = currentSeconds % 60;
            document.querySelectorAll('.wave-time')[0].textContent = 
                `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
        });

        // Track click interaction
        document.querySelectorAll('.track').forEach(track => {
            track.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.track').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
                
                // Move eq indicator
                const existingEq = document.querySelector('.track-eq');
                if (existingEq) {
                    const parent = existingEq.parentElement;
                    parent.removeChild(existingEq);
                }
                
                const eq = document.createElement('div');
                eq.className = 'track-eq';
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    eq.appendChild(document.createElement('span'));
                }
                this.querySelector('.track-info').after(eq);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Wavefront — Music for the Independent Soul</title>
    <style>
        /* ── Reset & Base ── */
        *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

        :root {
            --purple-deep:  #1a0a2e;
            --purple-mid:   #2d1b5e;
            --purple-light: #6b3fa0;
            --teal-dark:    #0d4a4a;
            --teal-mid:     #0f9b8e;
            --teal-bright:  #1de9d5;
            --teal-glow:    #00ffea;
            --text-primary: #f0eaff;
            --text-muted:   #a89bc2;
            --card-bg:      rgba(45, 27, 94, 0.45);
            --border:       rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.18);
        }

        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            background: var(--purple-deep);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* ── Scrollbar ── */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--purple-deep); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--teal-mid); border-radius: 3px; }

        /* ── Noise Texture Overlay ── */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        /* ── NAV ── */
        nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 1.2rem 6%;
            background: rgba(26, 10, 46, 0.75);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            transition: padding 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.55rem;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 36px; height: 36px;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .logo-wave {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .logo-wave span {
            display: block;
            width: 4px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            animation: logoWave 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .logo-wave span:nth-child(1) { height: 10px; animation-delay: 0s; }
        .logo-wave span:nth-child(2) { height: 20px; animation-delay: 0.15s; }
        .logo-wave span:nth-child(3) { height: 28px; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .logo-wave span:nth-child(4) { height: 20px; animation-delay: 0.45s; }
        .logo-wave span:nth-child(5) { height: 10px; animation-delay: 0.6s; }

        @keyframes logoWave {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; }
            50% { transform: scaleY(0.4); opacity: 0.5; }
        }

        .logo-text {
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .logo-text span { color: var(--teal-bright); }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
            transition: color 0.25s;
            position: relative;
        }

        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -3px; left: 0;
            width: 0; height: 1.5px;
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            transition: width 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--teal-bright); }
        .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

        .nav-cta {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-bright));
            color: var(--purple-deep) !important;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.3rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s !important;
        }

        .nav-cta::after { display: none !important; }

        .nav-cta:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.35) !important;
            color: var(--purple-deep) !important;
        }

        /* ── HERO ── */
        #hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 7rem 6% 4rem;
        }

        /* Ambient blobs */
        .blob {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(80px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .blob-1 {
            width: 600px; height: 600px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(107, 63, 160, 0.4) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -150px; left: -150px;
            animation: blobDrift 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        .blob-2 {
            width: 500px; height: 500px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(15, 155, 142, 0.35) 0%, transparent 70%);
            bottom: -100px; right: -100px;
            animation: blobDrift 15s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse;
        }

        .blob-3 {
            width: 300px; height: 300px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: 40%; left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            animation: blobDrift 10s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes blobDrift {
            from { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
            to   { transform: translate(30px, 20px) scale(1.08); }
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            max-width: 780px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 50px;
            padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease both;
        }

        .badge-dot {
            width: 7px; height: 7px;
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.7); }
        }

        .hero-title {
            font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.1s ease both;
        }

        .hero-title .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-bright) 0%, var(--purple-light) 60%, var(--teal-mid) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero-sub {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            max-width: 560px;
            margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.2s ease both;
        }

        .hero-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.3s ease both;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid) 0%, var(--teal-bright) 100%);
            color: var(--purple-deep);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.3);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.45);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            padding: 0.9rem 2rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.25s, border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.08);
            border-color: var(--teal-bright);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /* Hero Player Card */
        .hero-player {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            margin-top: 4rem;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.4s ease both;
        }

        .player-card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
            max-width: 480px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        }

        .player-top {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .album-art {
            width: 64px; height: 64px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-mid), var(--teal-dark));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .album-art::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(29,233,213,0.2), transparent);
        }

        .track-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

        .track-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .track-artist {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            margin-top: 0.15rem;
        }

        .track-tag {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            background: rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.12);
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            border: 1px solid rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.25);
            padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* Waveform */
        .waveform {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3px;
            height: 40px;
        }

        .waveform-bar {
            flex: 1;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: rgba(107, 63, 160, 0.5);
            transition: background 0.3s;
            animation: waveAnim 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .waveform-bar.played { background: var(--teal-bright); }

        @keyframes waveAnim {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
            50% { transform: scaleY(0.6); }
        }

        .player-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .ctrl-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 1rem;
            padding: 0.4rem;
            transition: color 0.2s;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .ctrl-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

        .ctrl-play {
            width: 46px; height: 46px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-bright));
            color: var(--purple-deep) !important;
            font-size: 1.1rem !important;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.35);
            transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s !important;
        }

        .ctrl-play:hover {
            transform: scale(1.08);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.5) !important;
        }

        .time-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: -0.5rem;
        }

        /* ── SECTION SHARED ── */
        section { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        .section-label {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.025em;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-desc {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            max-width: 500px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* ── STATS STRIP ── */
        #stats {
            padding: 3rem 6%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(13,74,74,0.3), rgba(45,27,94,0.3));
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .stats-grid {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-around;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 2rem;
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .stat-item { text-align: center; }

        .stat-num {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-bright), var(--purple-light));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: 0.2rem;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .stat-divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 50px;
            background: var(--border);
        }

        /* ── FEATURES ── */
        #features {
            padding: 7rem 6%;
        }

        .features-header {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 4.5rem;
        }

        .features-header .section-desc { margin: 0 auto; }

        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
            cursor: default;
        }

        .feature-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--teal-bright), transparent);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            border-color: rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.35);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 0 0 1px rgba(29,233,213,0.1);
        }

        .feature-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

        .feature-card.featured {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,155,142,0.2), rgba(45,27,94,0.6));
            border-color: rgba(29, 233, 213, 0.3);
            grid-column: span 2;
        }

        @media (max-width: 720px) {
            .feature-card.featured { grid-column: span 1; }
        }

        .feature-icon {
            width: 52px; height: 52px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .feature-icon.teal {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,155,142,0.3), rgba(29,233,213,0.15));
            border: 1px solid rgba(29,233,213,0.25);
        }

        .feature-icon.purple {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(107,63,160,0.3), rgba(45,27,94,0.4));
            border: 1px solid rgba(107,63,160,0.35);
        }

        .feature-icon.mixed {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,155,142,0.2), rgba(107,63,160,0.3));
            border: 1px solid rgba(29,233,213,0.2);
        }

        .feature-name {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .feature-desc {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            line-height: 1.65;
        }

        .feature-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 1rem;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            background: rgba(29,233,213,0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(29,233,213,0.2);
            padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
        }

        /* Featured card extra content */
        .mini-tracks {
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.6rem;
        }

        .mini-track {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
            border: 1px solid rgba(29,233,213,0.1);
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .mini-track:hover { background: rgba(29,233,213,0.08); }

        .mini-emoji { font-size: 1.2rem; }

        .mini-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

        .mini-name {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .mini-artist { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

        .mini-bars {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .mini-bar {
            width: 3px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            opacity: 0.7;
            animation: miniWave 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .mini-bar:nth-child(1) { height: 8px; animation-delay: 0s; }
        .mini-bar:nth-child(2) { height: 14px; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
        .mini-bar:nth-child(3) { height: 10px; animation-delay: 0.4s; }

        @keyframes miniWave {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
            50% { transform: scaleY(0.4); }
        }

        /* ── ARTISTS MARQUEE ── */
        #artists {
            padding: 5rem 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .artists-header {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0 6%;
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
        }

        .marquee-wrapper {
            position: relative;
        }

        .marquee-wrapper::before,
        .marquee-wrapper::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; bottom: 0;
            width: 120px;
            z-index: 2;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .marquee-wrapper::before {
            left: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple-deep), transparent);
        }

        .marquee-wrapper::after {
            right: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(-90deg, var(--purple-deep), transparent);
        }

        .marquee-track {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            animation: marquee 30s linear infinite;
            width: max-content;
        }

        .marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

        @keyframes marquee {
            from { transform: translateX(0); }
            to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
        }

        .artist-chip {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.7rem;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 50px;
            padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem 0.6rem 0.6rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
            cursor: default;
        }

        .artist-chip:hover {
            border-color: rgba(29,233,213,0.4);
            transform: scale(1.03);
        }

        .artist-avatar {
            width: 36px; height: 36px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .artist-name {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .artist-genre {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
        }

        /* ── HOW IT WORKS ── */
        #how {
            padding: 7rem 6%;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(13,74,74,0.12), transparent);
        }

        .how-container {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 5rem;
            align-items: center;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .how-container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3rem; }
        }

        .steps {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 2rem;
            margin-top: 2.5rem;
        }

        .step {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            align-items: flex-start;
            opacity: 0.7;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .step:hover { opacity: 1; }

        .step-num {
            width: 42px; height: 42px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-dark), var(--purple-mid));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .step-text h4 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        }

        .step-text p {
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Phone mockup */
        .phone-mockup {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .phone {
            width: 260px;
            background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--purple-mid), var(--purple-deep));
            border: 2px solid rgba(107,63,160,0.5);
            border-radius: 40px;
            padding: 1.5rem 1.2rem;
            box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            position: relative;
        }

        .phone::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 12px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 70px; height: 5px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .phone-screen {
            background: var(--purple-deep);
            border-radius: 28px;
            padding: 1.2rem 1rem;
            min-height: 420px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1rem;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(107,63,160,0.3);
        }

        .phone-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .phone-title { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-muted); }
        .phone-icon { font-size: 1rem; }

        .phone-featured {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,155,142,0.3), rgba(107,63,160,0.3));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 1rem;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .phone-album { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }

        .phone-track { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; }
        .phone-artist { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--teal-bright); margin-top: 0.15rem; }

        .phone-progress {
            height: 3px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-top: 0.8rem;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .phone-progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 40%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-bright));
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .phone-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .phone-row-label { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

        .phone-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .phone-item:hover { background: rgba(29,233,213,0.06); }

        .phone-item-emoji { font-size: 1rem; }
        .phone-item-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .phone-item-name { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
        .phone-item-sub { font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
        .phone-item-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal-bright); opacity: 0.7; }

        /* ── CTA ── */
        #cta {
            padding: 8rem 6%;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cta-glow {
            position: absolute;
            width: 700px; height: 700px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(15,155,142,0.2) 0%, transparent 65%);
            top: 50%; left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cta-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            max-width: 650px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .cta-title {
            font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }

        .cta-sub {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .cta-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .cta-note {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .cta-note span { color: var(--teal-bright); }

        /* Store Buttons */
        .store-btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.7rem;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            transition: background 0.25s, border-color 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
        }

        .store-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(29,233,213,0.08);
            border-color: rgba(29,233,213,0.35);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .store-icon { font-size: 1.4rem; }

        .store-text small { display: block; font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
        .store-text strong { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; }

        /* ── FOOTER ── */
        footer {
            padding: 3rem 6%;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .footer-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .footer-copy {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .footer-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .footer-links a {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.2s;
        }

        .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--teal-bright); }

        .social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.8rem;
        }

        .social-btn {
            width: 36px; height: 36px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .social-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(29,233,213,0.1);
            border-color: rgba(29,233,213,0.3);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        /* ── Animations ── */
        @keyframes fadeUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
            to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease;
        }

        .reveal.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        /* ── Mobile ── */
        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .nav-links { display: none; }
            .stat-divider { display: none; }
            .stats-grid { gap: 1.5rem; }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<script>
    /* ── Waveform Generator ── */
    (function buildWaveform() {

        const bars = 48;
        const playedRatio = 0.37;
        for (let i = 0; i < bars; i++) {
            const bar = document.createElement('div');
            bar.className = 'waveform-bar' + (i / bars < playedRatio ? ' played' : '');
            const h = 8 + Math.random() * 28;
            bar.style.height = h + 'px';
            bar.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 1.5) + 's';
            bar.style.animationDuration = (1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8) + 's';
            wf.appendChild(bar);
        }
    })();

    /* ── Marquee Builder ── */
    (function buildMarquee() {
        const artists = [
            { emoji: '🎸', name: 'The Drift', genre: 'Post-Rock' },
            { emoji: '🌙', name: 'Solara', genre: 'Dream Pop' },
            { emoji: '🔥', name: 'Caspian Rowe', genre: 'Lo-fi Hip-Hop' },
            { emoji: '💜', name: 'Mira Shade', genre: 'Alt R&B' },
            { emoji: '🌊', name: 'Luna Vex', genre: 'Indie Electronic' },
            { emoji: '🎹', name: 'Elliot Fern', genre: 'Neo-Soul' },
            { emoji: '🦋', name: 'Prism Cult', genre: 'Shoegaze' },
            { emoji: '🌿', name: 'Oak & Ember', genre: 'Folk' },
            { emoji: '⚡', name: 'Static Bloom', genre: 'Noise Pop' },
            { emoji: '🎺', name: 'Ivory Coast', genre: 'Jazz Fusion' },
            { emoji: '🌸', name: 'Petal Riot', genre: 'Bedroom Pop' },
            { emoji: '🖤', name: 'Void Mirror', genre: 'Dark Ambient' },
            { emoji: '🎻', name: 'Sable String', genre: 'Neoclassical' },
            { emoji: '🏔️', name: 'Alpine Static', genre: 'Math Rock' },
            { emoji: '🦊', name: 'Fennec Sound', genre: 'Indie Folk' },
            { emoji: '🌀', name: 'Spiral Haze', genre: 'Psychedelic' },
        ];

        const track = document.getElementById('marqueeTrack');
        const avatarColors = [
            'linear-gradient(135deg,#1a0a2e,#0f9b8e)',
            'linear-gradient(135deg,#2d1b5e,#1de9d5)',
            'linear-gradient(135deg,#0d4a4a,#6b3fa0)',
            'linear-gradient(135deg,#6b3fa0,#0f9b8e)',
        ];

        // Duplicate for seamless loop
        [...artists, ...artists].forEach((a, i) => {
            const chip = document.createElement('div');
            chip.className = 'artist-chip';
            chip.innerHTML = `
                <div class="artist-avatar" style="background:${avatarColors[i % avatarColors.length]}">${a.emoji}</div>
                <div>
                    <div class="artist-name">${a.name}</div>
                    <div class="artist-genre">${a.genre}</div>
                </div>
            `;
            track.appendChild(chip);
        });
    })();

    /* ── Scroll Reveal ── */
    (function initReveal() {
        const els = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, idx) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    // Stagger siblings
                    const siblings = Array.from(entry.target.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.reveal'));
                    const i = siblings.indexOf(entry.target);
                    entry.target.style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.08) + 's';
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

        els.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
    })();

    /* ── Nav Shrink on Scroll ── */
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        const nav = document.querySelector('nav');
        if (window.scrollY > 60) {
            nav.style.padding = '0.8rem 6%';
        } else {
            nav.style.padding = '1.2rem 6%';
        }
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── Play Button Toggle ── */
    const playBtn = document.querySelector('.ctrl-play');
    let playing = false;
    playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        playing = !playing;
        playBtn.innerHTML = playing
            ? `<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M6 19h4V5H6v14zm8-14v14h4V5h-4z"/></svg>`
            : `<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M6 19h4V5H6v14zm8-14v14l11-7z"/></svg>`;
        // Pause/play waveform animation
        document.querySelectorAll('.waveform-bar').forEach(bar => {
            bar.style.animationPlayState = playing ? 'running' : 'paused';
        });
    });
</script>
