    <script>
        // ── Waveform bars ──
        const waveform = document.getElementById('waveform');
        const barCount = 60;
        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
            const bar = document.createElement('div');
            bar.className = 'wave-bar';
            const h = 15 + Math.random() * 45;
            bar.style.setProperty('--h', h + 'px');
            bar.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.04) + 's';
            waveform.appendChild(bar);
        }

        // ── Artists marquee ──
        const artists = [
            { name: 'Luna Eclipse', initials: 'LE', color: '#5eead4' },
            { name: 'The Hollows', initials: 'TH', color: '#8b5fbf' },
            { name: 'Neon Drift', initials: 'ND', color: '#5eead4' },
            { name: 'Amber Fields', initials: 'AF', color: '#8b5fbf' },
            { name: 'Static Bloom', initials: 'SB', color: '#5eead4' },
            { name: 'Pale Mirage', initials: 'PM', color: '#8b5fbf' },
            { name: 'Velvet Noise', initials: 'VN', color: '#5eead4' },
            { name: 'Ghost Circuit', initials: 'GC', color: '#8b5fbf' },
            { name: 'Soft Collapse', initials: 'SC', color: '#5eead4' },
            { name: 'Dawn Protocol', initials: 'DP', color: '#8b5fbf' },
            { name: 'Ember Wave', initials: 'EW', color: '#5eead4' },
            { name: 'Silk & Steel', initials: 'SS', color: '#8b5fbf' },
        ];

        const marquee = document.getElementById('marquee');
        const allArtists = [...artists, ...artists];
        allArtists.forEach(a => {
            const chip = document.createElement('div');
            chip.className = 'artist-chip';
            chip.innerHTML = `
                <div class="artist-avatar" style="background:${a.color}22;color:${a.color}">${a.initials}</div>
                <span>${a.name}</span>
            `;
            marquee.appendChild(chip);
        });

        // ── Navbar scroll ──
        const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            navbar.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 50);
        });

        // ── Reveal on scroll ──
        const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, i * 100);
                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.15 });

        reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

        // ── Counter animation ──
        const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
        const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const el = entry.target;
                    const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
                    const duration = 2000;
                    const start = performance.now();

                    function update(now) {
                        const elapsed = now - start;
                        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
                        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
                        const current = Math.floor(eased * target);

                        if (target >= 1000) {
                            el.textContent = (current / 1000).toFixed(current >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + 'K+';
                        } else {
                            el.textContent = current + '%';
                        }

                        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
                    }

                    requestAnimationFrame(update);
                    counterObserver.unobserve(el);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.5 });

        statNumbers.forEach(el => counterObserver.observe(el));

        // ── CTA Button ──
        const ctaBtn = document.getElementById('ctaBtn');
        const emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');

        ctaBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const email = emailInput.value.trim();
            if (email && email.includes('@')) {
                ctaBtn.textContent = '✓ You\'re in!';
                ctaBtn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #22c55e, #16a34a)';
                ctaBtn.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 25px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3)';
                emailInput.value = '';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ctaBtn.textContent = 'Join Waitlist';
                    ctaBtn.style.background = '';
                    ctaBtn.style.boxShadow = '';
                }, 3000);
            } else {
                emailInput.style.borderColor = '#ef4444';
                emailInput.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 3px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    emailInput.style.borderColor = '';
                    emailInput.style.boxShadow = '';
                }, 2000);
            }
        });

        emailInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') ctaBtn.click();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--purple-light), transparent 70%);
            top: 40%;
            left: 30%;
            animation-delay: -5s;
            opacity: 0.3;
        }

        @keyframes orbFloat {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
            33% { transform: translate(30px, -30px) scale(1.05); }
            66% { transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(0.95); }
        }

        .hero-grid {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 900px;
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.45rem 1.2rem;
            background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.25);
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--purple-light);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .hero-badge .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.5); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -2px;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.15s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .hero h1 .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light) 0%, var(--teal-mid) 40%, var(--purple-light) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
            color: var(--gray);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.7;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.3s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.45s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 1rem 2.2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-accent));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 60px;
            color: white;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn-primary::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-accent), var(--teal-mid));
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .btn-primary span {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.25);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 1rem 2.2rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 60px;
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        .hero-visual {
            margin-top: 4rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.6s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .player-mockup {
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 2rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            position: relative;
        }

        .player-mockup::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -1px;
            border-radius: 25px;
            padding: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2), transparent 50%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.2));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .player-top {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .player-art {
            width: 64px;
            height: 64px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-accent), var(--teal-mid));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .player-art::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .player-art::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .player-info {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .player-info .song-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
        }

        .player-info .artist-name {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        .player-bars {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 3px;
            height: 20px;
        }

        .player-bars .bar {
            width: 3px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            border-radius: 2px;
            animation: barBounce 1s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .player-bars .bar:nth-child(1) { height: 8px; animation-delay: 0s; }
        .player-bars .bar:nth-child(2) { height: 16px; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
        .player-bars .bar:nth-child(3) { height: 10px; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
        .player-bars .bar:nth-child(4) { height: 18px; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .player-bars .bar:nth-child(5) { height: 6px; animation-delay: 0.4s; }

        @keyframes barBounce {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
            50% { transform: scaleY(0.4); }
        }

        .player-progress {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            width: 65%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-accent));
            border-radius: 4px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .progress-fill::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            right: -5px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.5);
        }

        .progress-times {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--gray);
        }

        .player-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .player-controls button {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--gray);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .player-controls button:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .player-controls .play-btn {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-accent));
            border-radius: 50%;
            color: white;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .player-controls .play-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.3);
        }

        /* Wave SVG divider */
        .wave-divider {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .wave-divider svg {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
        }

        /* ===== FEATURES ===== */
        .features {
            padding: 8rem 3rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 650px;
            margin: 0 auto 4rem;
        }

        .section-label {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: var(--teal-mid);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-label::before,
        .section-label::after {
            content: '';
            width: 20px;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--teal-mid);
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -1px;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-header p {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1.5rem;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .feature-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-accent), transparent);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-5px);
        }

        .feature-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .feature-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .feature-icon.purple {
            background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
            color: var(--purple-light);
        }

        .feature-icon.teal {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.12);
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        .feature-icon.mixed {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.12));
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.3px;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .feature-card.featured {
            grid-row: span 2;
            background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.08), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.04));
            border-color: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
        }

        .feature-card.featured .featured-visual {
            margin-top: 2rem;
            padding-top: 2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        }

        .mini-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 6px;
            height: 80px;
            padding: 0 0.5rem;
        }

        .mini-chart .chart-bar {
            flex: 1;
            border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--purple-accent), var(--teal-mid));
            opacity: 0.6;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mini-chart .chart-bar:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        /* ===== STATS ===== */
        .stats {
            padding: 4rem 3rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .stats-inner {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 2rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 3rem;
        }

        .stat-item {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 3vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light), var(--purple-light));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        }

        .stat-label {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===== CTA ===== */
        .cta {
            padding: 8rem 3rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .cta-inner {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .cta-bg-orb {
            position: absolute;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(120px);
            opacity: 0.3;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cta-bg-orb.orb-a {
            background: var(--purple-accent);
            top: -200px;
            left: -100px;
        }

        .cta-bg-orb.orb-b {
            background: var(--teal-mid);
            bottom: -200px;
            right: -100px;
        }

        .cta h2 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -1.5px;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            line-height: 1.1;
        }

        .cta p {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            max-width: 550px;
            margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .cta-email {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            max-width: 480px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 60px;
            padding: 0.4rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .cta-email input {
            flex: 1;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
        }

        .cta-email input::placeholder {
            color: var(--gray);
        }

        .cta-email button {
            padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-accent));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            color: white;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .cta-email button:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.3);
        }

        .cta-note {
            margin-top: 1rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.6);
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
        footer {
            padding: 3rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .footer-inner {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .footer-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
        }

        .footer-left svg {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
        }

        .footer-left span {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .footer-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
        }

        .footer-links a {
            color: var(--gray);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .footer-links a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .footer-copy {
            color: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.5);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(30px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .reveal.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .features-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .feature-card.featured {
                grid-row: span 1;
            }

            .stats-inner {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            nav {
                padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            }

            nav.scrolled {
                padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem;
            }

            .nav-links {
                display: none;
                position: absolute;
                top: 100%;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
                flex-direction: column;
                background: rgba(13, 4, 21, 0.95);
                backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
                padding: 2rem;
                gap: 1.5rem;
                border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
            }

            .nav-links.open {
                display: flex;
            }

            .mobile-toggle {
                display: flex;
            }

            .hero {
                padding: 7rem 1.5rem 3rem;
            }

            .features {
                padding: 5rem 1.5rem;
            }

            .features-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-inner {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
                padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
            }

            .cta {
                padding: 5rem 1.5rem;
            }

            .cta-email {
                flex-direction: column;
                border-radius: 20px;
                padding: 0.5rem;
            }

            .cta-email input {
                width: 100%;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .cta-email button {
                width: 100%;
            }

            footer {
                padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
            }

            .footer-inner {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .player-top {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .hero h1 {
                letter-spacing: -1px;
            }

            .stats-inner {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

                            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00d4aa"/>
                            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7c3aed"/>

    <script>
        // Navbar scroll effect
        const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
        let lastScroll = 0;

        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
            if (currentScroll > 50) {
                navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
            } else {
                navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
            }
            lastScroll = currentScroll;
        });

        // Mobile menu toggle
        const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
        const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');

        mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
            const spans = mobileToggle.querySelectorAll('span');
            if (navLinks.classList.contains('open')) {
                spans[0].style.transform = 'rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px)';
                spans[1].style.opacity = '0';
                spans[2].style.transform = 'rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px)';
            } else {
                spans[0].style.transform = 'none';
                spans[1].style.opacity = '1';
                spans[2].style.transform = 'none';
            }
        });

        // Close mobile menu on link click
        navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navLinks.classList.remove('open');
                const spans = mobileToggle.querySelectorAll('span');
                spans[0].style.transform = 'none';
                spans[1].style.opacity = '1';
                spans[2].style.transform = 'none';
            });
        });

        // Scroll reveal
        const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');

        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, index * 100);
                    revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        });

        revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

        // Smooth scroll for anchor links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            });
        });

        // Parallax effect on hero orbs
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 2;
            const y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;

            document.querySelectorAll('.orb').forEach((orb, i) => {
                const speed = (i + 1) * 8;
                orb.style.transform = `translate(${x * speed}px, ${y * speed}px)`;
            });
        });
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Wavefront — Stream Indie Music</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --purple-deep: #1a0a2e;
            --purple-dark: #2d1b69;
            --purple-mid: #5b21b6;
            --purple-light: #7c3aed;
            --purple-glow: #a78bfa;
            --teal-dark: #0d4f4f;
            --teal-mid: #0f766e;
            --teal-light: #14b8a6;
            --teal-glow: #5eead4;
            --white: #f8fafc;
            --gray-100: #e2e8f0;
            --gray-300: #94a3b8;
            --gray-500: #64748b;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: var(--purple-deep);
            color: var(--white);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;

        /* ===== NAVBAR ===== */
        nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 1.25rem 3rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        nav.scrolled {
            background: rgba(26, 10, 46, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            padding: 0.85rem 3rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
        }

        .nav-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .nav-logo svg {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
        }

        .nav-logo span {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2.5rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--gray-300);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s;
            position: relative;
        }

        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -4px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            transition: width 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .nav-links a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.7rem 1.6rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-light), var(--teal-mid));
            color: var(--white);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.4);

            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.6);

            background: transparent;

        .btn-outline:hover {
            border-color: var(--teal-light);
            color: var(--teal-light);
            transform: translateY(-2px);

        .btn-large {
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
        }

        /* ===== HERO ===== */
        .hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;

        .hero-bg {

                navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
            }
        });

        // Waveform generator
        const waveform = document.getElementById('waveform');
        const barCount = 120;
        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
            const bar = document.createElement('div');
            bar.className = 'waveform-bar';
            const h = Math.max(8, Math.sin(i * 0.15) * 35 + Math.random() * 25 + 15);
            bar.style.setProperty('--h', h + 'px');
            bar.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.03) + 's';
            waveform.appendChild(bar);
        }

        // Scroll reveal
        const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, index * 100);
                    revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        });

        revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

                e.preventDefault();

                if (target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });

            });

        // Parallax effect on orbs
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 2;
            const y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;
            document.querySelectorAll('.orb').forEach((orb, i) => {
                const speed = (i + 1) * 8;
                orb.style.transform = `translate(${x * speed}px, ${y * speed}px)`;
            });
        });

question: website-landing-page
prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta
    name="description"
    content="Wavefront is a music streaming platform built to help listeners discover independent artists."
  />
  <title>Wavefront — Hear what’s next</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #090713;
      --bg-soft: #100c20;
      --surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      --surface-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
      --text: #f7f5ff;
      --muted: #aaa4bc;
      --purple: #8d5cff;
      --purple-light: #b79aff;
      --teal: #2de2c5;
      --teal-dark: #0fa58f;
      --shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
      --radius-lg: 30px;
      --radius-md: 20px;
      --radius-sm: 14px;
      --max-width: 1180px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--text);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 6%, rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.12), transparent 26rem),
        radial-gradient(circle at 8% 28%, rgba(141, 92, 255, 0.16), transparent 28rem),
        var(--bg);
      font-family:
        Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button,
    a {
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    button {
      font: inherit;
    }

    img,
    svg {
      display: block;
    }

    .container {
      width: min(calc(100% - 40px), var(--max-width));
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0 0 18px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      width: 24px;
      height: 1px;
      background: currentColor;
      content: "";
    }

    .section-heading {
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
      line-height: 1.06;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .section-copy {
      max-width: 620px;
      margin: 20px 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .button {
      display: inline-flex;
      min-height: 52px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 0 22px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 0.94rem;
      font-weight: 750;
      transition:
        transform 180ms ease,
        background 180ms ease,
        border-color 180ms ease,
        box-shadow 180ms ease;
    }

    .button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .button-primary {
      color: #07110f;
      background: var(--teal);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.2);
    }

    .button-primary:hover {
      background: #62f0da;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.28);
    }

    .button-secondary {
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border-color: var(--border);
    }

    .button-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    }

    /* Navigation */
    .site-header {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 24px 0;
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .brand {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 11px;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 820;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      display: grid;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.3);
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: var(--teal);
      background: rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.09);
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      color: #c5c0d2;
      font-size: 0.91rem;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      transition: color 160ms ease;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .nav-action {
      min-height: 42px;
      padding-inline: 18px;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 760px;
      padding: 82px 0 122px;
    }

    .hero::after {
      position: absolute;
      right: -240px;
      bottom: 90px;
      width: 520px;
      height: 520px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(141, 92, 255, 0.13);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 75px rgba(141, 92, 255, 0.025),
        0 0 0 150px rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.018);
      content: "";
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.03fr) minmax(400px, 0.82fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 80px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      max-width: 740px;
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 7vw, 6.8rem);
      font-weight: 820;
      line-height: 0.92;
      letter-spacing: -0.068em;
    }

    .hero h1 span {
      color: transparent;
      background: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--purple-light), var(--teal));
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-copy {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 28px 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.02rem, 2vw, 1.18rem);
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 34px;
    }

    .proof {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 13px;
      margin-top: 32px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.83rem;
    }

    .avatar-stack {
      display: flex;
      padding-left: 8px;
    }

    .avatar {
      display: grid;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      margin-left: -8px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 2px solid var(--bg);
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .avatar:nth-child(1) { background: #6b42cd; }
    .avatar:nth-child(2) { background: #147f78; }
    .avatar:nth-child(3) { background: #b34876; }
    .avatar:nth-child(4) { background: #4663a8; }

    /* Player */
    .player-wrap {
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .player-glow {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: -1;
      inset: 16% 4% 5%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--teal));
      filter: blur(65px);
      opacity: 0.32;
    }

    .player-card {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 18px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background:
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035)),
        rgba(14, 10, 27, 0.84);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      transform: rotate(2deg);
    }

    .player-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 2px 4px 14px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: 0.11em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .signal {
      display: flex;
      height: 14px;
      align-items: end;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .signal i {
      display: block;
      width: 3px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--teal);
      animation: pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .signal i:nth-child(1) { height: 5px; }
    .signal i:nth-child(2) { height: 12px; animation-delay: -0.4s; }
    .signal i:nth-child(3) { height: 8px; animation-delay: -0.7s; }
    .signal i:nth-child(4) { height: 14px; animation-delay: -0.2s; }

    @keyframes pulse {
      to { transform: scaleY(0.45); opacity: 0.55; }
    }

    .album-art {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 0.82;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 64% 42%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) 0 2%, transparent 2.3%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 62% 44%, transparent 0 10%, rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.8) 10.5% 11.8%, transparent 12.2%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 60% 46%, transparent 0 22%, rgba(183, 154, 255, 0.7) 22.5% 24%, transparent 24.5%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 58% 48%, transparent 0 35%, rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.22) 35.5% 37%, transparent 37.5%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #251547, #0f847d);
    }

    .album-art::before,
    .album-art::after {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      content: "";
    }

    .album-art::before {
      top: -35%;
      left: -12%;
      width: 74%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border: 22px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 28px rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.05),
        0 0 0 55px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
    }

    .album-art::after {
      right: -12%;
      bottom: -30%;
      width: 70%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      background: rgba(5, 9, 20, 0.32);
      filter: blur(2px);
    }

    .album-label {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 1;
      bottom: 22px;
      left: 24px;
    }

    .album-label small {
      display: block;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .album-label strong {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .track-info {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 22px 6px 14px;
    }

    .track-info h2 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    }

    .track-info p {
      margin: 2px 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .favorite {
      display: grid;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: var(--purple-light);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .progress {
      height: 4px;
      margin: 0 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
    }

    .progress span {
      display: block;
      width: 42%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple), var(--teal));
    }

    .times {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin: 7px 6px 0;
      color: #777188;
      font-size: 0.68rem;
    }

    .controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 25px;
      padding: 10px 0 3px;
    }

    .control {
      display: grid;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      place-items: center;
      color: #ded9eb;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .play {
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #07110f;
      background: var(--teal);
      box-shadow: 0 9px 24px rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.22);
    }

    .floating-tag {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 3;
      right: -38px;
      bottom: 78px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      color: #dcd8e7;
      background: rgba(18, 13, 34, 0.9);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }

    .floating-tag i {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--teal);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(45, 226, 197, 0.12);
    }

    /* Features */
    .features {
      position: relative;
      padding: 112px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015);
    }

    .features-intro {
      display: flex;
      align-items: end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 40px;
    }

    .features-intro .section-copy {
      max-width: 420px;
      margin: 0 0 5px;
    }

    .feature-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 58px;
    }

            <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">

      <div class="footer-links">
        <a href="#">Privacy</a>
        <a href="#">Terms</a>
        <a href="#">Instagram</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script>
    document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    const playButton = document.getElementById("playButton");
    const playIcon = document.getElementById("playIcon");
    let isPlaying = false;

    playButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      isPlaying = !isPlaying;
      playButton.setAttribute("aria-label", isPlaying ? "Pause track" : "Play track");
      playIcon.innerHTML = isPlaying
        ? '<path d="M7 5h4v14H7V5zm6 0h4v14h-4V5z"/>'
        : '<path d="M8 5v14l11-7L8 5z"/>';
    });
  </script>

question: website-landing-page
prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Wavefront — Independent music, amplified.</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: #0B0614;
            --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            --text: #F4F0FF;
            --muted: #A99FC7;
            --teal: #2DD4BF;
            --teal-bright: #5EEAD4;
            --purple: #8B5CF6;
            --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            background:
                radial-gradient(900px 500px at 85% 0%, rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.08), transparent 60%),
                radial-gradient(800px 600px at 10% 20%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.10), transparent 60%),
                var(--bg);
            background-color: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.5;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
        }

        .container {
            width: min(1120px, calc(100% - 48px));
            margin-inline: auto;
        }

        /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
        .nav {
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 50;
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            background: rgba(11, 6, 20, 0.7);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .nav .container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            height: 72px;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--text);
        }

        .logo-mark {
            color: var(--teal);
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 28px;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            transition: color 0.2s;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        .nav-links .nav-cta {
            background: var(--teal);
            color: #061a17;
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .nav-links .nav-cta:hover {
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            color: #061a17;
        }

        /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
        .hero {
            padding: 120px 0 80px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hero .container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
            gap: 64px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hero-copy {
            max-width: 560px;
        }

        .eyebrow {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            background: rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.08);
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            border: 1px solid rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.2);
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .eyebrow .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: var(--teal);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--teal);
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.5;
                transform: scale(0.8);
            }
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.25rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.04em;
            line-height: 1.05;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .gradient {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), var(--purple));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            color: transparent;
        }

        .hero-sub {
            font-size: 1.125rem;
            color: var(--muted);
            max-width: 480px;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .hero-ctas {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 14px 28px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 1rem;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--teal);
            color: #061a17;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.25);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--teal);
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .hero-note {
            margin-top: 20px;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        /* ---------- Hero Visual ---------- */
        .hero-art {
            position: relative;
        }

        .hero-orb {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(60px);
            opacity: 0.2;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .hero-orb-1 {
            width: 340px;
            height: 340px;
            background: var(--teal);
            top: -40px;
            right: -40px;
        }

        .hero-orb-2 {
            width: 320px;
            height: 320px;
            background: var(--purple);
            bottom: -40px;
            left: -20px;
        }

        .player {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 420px;
            margin-left: auto;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 28px;
            padding: 28px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }

        .player-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .player-label {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: var(--teal);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--teal);
        }

        .player-menu {
            color: var(--muted);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .cover-art {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 1;
            border-radius: 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.45), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.55));
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }

        .disc {
            width: 64%;
            aspect-ratio: 1;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: repeating-radial-gradient(circle, #241340 0 2px, #0E0718 2px 4px);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            animation: spin 18s linear infinite;
            position: relative;
        }

        .disc::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 38%;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, #0B0614 0 18%, var(--teal) 19% 100%);
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        .track-info {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .track-name {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .artist-name {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        .equalizer {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 6px;
            height: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .eq-bar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--teal), var(--teal-bright));
            border-radius: 999px;
            animation: eq-bounce 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
            transform-origin: bottom;
        }

        .eq-bar:nth-child(1) {
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }

        .eq-bar:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: 0.2s;
        }

        .eq-bar:nth-child(3) {
            animation-delay: 0.4s;
        }

        .eq-bar:nth-child(4) {
            animation-delay: 0.1s;
        }

        .eq-bar:nth-child(5) {
            animation-delay: 0.3s;
        }

        @keyframes eq-bounce {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: scaleY(0.3);
                opacity: 0.5;
            }
            50% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .progress {
            height: 4px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            height: 100%;
            width: 45%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal), var(--teal-bright));
            border-radius: 999px;
        }

        .player-controls {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 28px;
        }

        .ctl {
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 50%;
            color: var(--muted);
        }

        .ctl svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
        }

        .ctl.play {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            background: var(--teal);
            border: none;
            color: #061a17;
        }

        .ctl.play svg {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
        }

        .float-bubble {
            position: absolute;
            z-index: 3;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 12px 18px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .bubble-1 {
            top: 40px;
            left: -20px;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
        }

        .bubble-2 {
            bottom: 20px;
            right: -20px;
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
        .section {
            padding: 100px 0;
        }

        #features,
        #cta {
            scroll-margin-top: 80px;
        }

        .section-head {
            max-width: 640px;
            margin: 0 auto 64px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .section-head h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .section-head p {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 1.125rem;
        }

        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 32px;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-color: rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.3);
        }

        .feature-icon {
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            background: rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.2);
            color: var(--teal);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .feature-icon svg {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        /* ---------- CTA ---------- */
        .cta {
            padding: 120px 0;
        }

        .cta-card {
            position: relative;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12), rgba(45, 212, 175, 0.10));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 32px;
            padding: 72px 48px;
            text-align: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cta-card::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: -120px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: var(--teal);
            opacity: 0.15;
            filter: blur(100px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cta-card h2 {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .cta-card p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            color: var(--muted);
            max-width: 440px;
            margin: 0 auto 36px;
            font-size: 1.125rem;
        }

        .cta-form {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            max-width: 480px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .cta-form input {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: rgba(11, 6, 20, 0.6);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 1rem;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .cta-form input:focus {
            border-color: var(--teal);
        }

        .cta-form input::placeholder {
            color: var(--muted);
        }

        .cta-form button {
            background: var(--teal);
            color: #061a17;
            padding: 14px 28px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            border: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .cta-form button:hover {
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .cta-note {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            margin-top: 20px;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
        .footer {
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 48px 0;
        }

        .footer .container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .footer-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;

                <article class="feature-card">
