question: website-landing-page
prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Wavefront — Indie Music Streaming</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --purple-950: #0d0620;
            --purple-900: #150a30;
            --purple-800: #1e0f45;
            --purple-700: #2a1558;
            --purple-600: #3b1d70;
            --purple-500: #4c2a8a;
            --purple-400: #6b3fb5;
            --purple-300: #8b5fd9;
            --teal-500: #14b8a6;
            --teal-400: #2dd4bf;
            --teal-300: #5eead4;
            --teal-200: #99f6e4;
            --teal-glow: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.35);
            --text-primary: #f0edf7;
            --text-secondary: #b8b0cc;
            --text-muted: #7a7194;
            --surface-glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            --surface-glass-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            --border-glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            --border-teal: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.3);
            --border-purple: rgba(107, 63, 181, 0.3);
            --font-sans: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', 'Inter', sans-serif;
            --transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            --ease-bounce: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
            scroll-padding-top: 80px;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            background-color: var(--purple-950);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }

        /* ─── Background ambient glow ─── */
        .bg-ambient {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .bg-ambient::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -30%;
            left: -10%;
            width: 60%;
            height: 60%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(107, 63, 181, 0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
            filter: blur(60px);
            animation: driftGlow1 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        .bg-ambient::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -20%;
            right: -10%;
            width: 50%;
            height: 55%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
            filter: blur(50px);
            animation: driftGlow2 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        @keyframes driftGlow1 {
            0% {
                transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate(8%, 5%) scale(1.15);
            }
        }
        @keyframes driftGlow2 {
            0% {
                transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate(-6%, -4%) scale(1.1);
            }
        }

        /* ─── Navigation ─── */
        .navbar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 0 2rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            background: rgba(13, 6, 32, 0.7);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .navbar-inner {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            height: 70px;
        }
        .nav-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .nav-logo .logo-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-500), var(--teal-500));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.3);
        }
        .nav-logo .logo-icon svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            fill: none;
            stroke: #fff;
            stroke-width: 2.5;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }
        .nav-logo span {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 0%, var(--teal-200) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2rem;
            list-style: none;
        }
        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
        }
        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -4px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--teal-400);
            transition: var(--transition);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .nav-links a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }
        .btn-nav {
            padding: 0.55rem 1.4rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-500), var(--teal-400));
            color: var(--purple-950);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.3);
        }
        .btn-nav:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.45);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-400), var(--teal-300));
        }
        .mobile-toggle {
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            padding: 4px;
        }
        .mobile-toggle span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--text-primary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        /* ─── Main Container ─── */
        .main-container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* ─── Hero Section ─── */
        .hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 120px 2rem 80px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .hero-inner {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
            background: var(--surface-glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-teal);
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--teal-300);
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.2s both;
        }
        .hero-badge .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--teal-400);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulseDot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulseDot {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.4;
                transform: scale(0.7);
            }
        }
        .hero-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.04em;
            line-height: 1.05;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.35s both;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #c4b5fd 40%, var(--teal-300) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        .hero-subtitle {
            font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.3rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 620px;
            margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.5s both;
        }
        .hero-subtitle strong {
            color: var(--teal-300);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .hero-cta {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.65s both;
        }
        .btn-primary {
            padding: 1rem 2.2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-500), var(--teal-400));
            color: var(--purple-950);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.35);
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 45px rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.5);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-400), var(--teal-300));
        }
        .btn-secondary {
            padding: 1rem 2.2rem;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 1.5px solid var(--border-glass);
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }
        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-teal);
            color: var(--teal-300);
            background: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.06);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /* ─── Waveform Visual ─── */
        .waveform-visual {
            margin-top: 3.5rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 4px;
            height: 140px;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.8s both;
            position: relative;
        }
        .waveform-visual .wave-bar {
            width: 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--purple-600), var(--teal-400));
            animation: waveBounce 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
            transform-origin: bottom;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.4);
        }
        .wave-bar:nth-child(1) {
            height: 35px;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }
        .wave-bar:nth-child(2) {
            height: 70px;
            animation-delay: 0.1s;
        }
        .wave-bar:nth-child(3) {
            height: 50px;
            animation-delay: 0.2s;
        }
        .wave-bar:nth-child(4) {
            height: 100px;
            animation-delay: 0.05s;
        }

        const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');

        toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
            navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
            const spans = toggle.querySelectorAll('span');
            if (navLinks.classList.contains('open')) {
                spans[0].style.transform = 'rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px)';
                spans[1].style.opacity = '0';
                spans[2].style.transform = 'rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px)';
            } else {
                spans[0].style.transform = '';
                spans[1].style.opacity = '';
                spans[2].style.transform = '';
            }
        });

        // Close mobile nav when a link is clicked
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a').forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navLinks.classList.remove('open');
                const spans = toggle.querySelectorAll('span');
                spans[0].style.transform = '';
                spans[1].style.opacity = '';
                spans[2].style.transform = '';
            });
        });

        // Navbar background on scroll
        const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 40) {
                navbar.style.background = 'rgba(13, 6, 32, 0.92)';
                navbar.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
            } else {
                navbar.style.background = 'rgba(13, 6, 32, 0.7)';
                navbar.style.boxShadow = 'none';
            }
        });
    </script>

      --gradient-surface: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 100%);
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;

    body {

    .ambient-glow {

    .glow-1 {
      top: -150px;
      left: -100px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #5b21b6 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .glow-2 {
      top: 30%;
      right: -200px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #0f766e 0%, transparent 70%);
      opacity: 0.35;
    }
    .glow-3 {
      bottom: -150px;
      left: 20%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #7c3aed 0%, transparent 70%);
      opacity: 0.3;
    }

    /* Grid overlay pattern */
    .bg-grid-pattern {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 32px 32px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 40%, transparent 80%);
      -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 40%, transparent 80%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;

    .container {

      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .text-gradient-purple {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c084fc 0%, #8b5cf6 100%);

      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .text-gradient-teal {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #0cdac5 100%);

      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;

    /* Navigation */
    header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;

      padding: 20px 0;

      padding: 14px 0;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2e1065, #115e59);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--purple-glow);

    .logo-icon svg {

      height: 20px;
      stroke: var(--teal-primary);

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      list-style: none;

      color: #fff;
    }
    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;

      justify-content: center;

    .btn-lg {

    /* Hero Section */
    .hero {

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6.5vw, 4.8rem);

    .hero p {

    .hero-buttons {
      display: flex;

    /* Audio Interactive Player Hero Mockup */
    .player-showcase {
      max-width: 940px;

    .track-artwork-wrap {

    /* Vinyl spin illusion */
    .vinyl-disc {
      position: absolute;

      right: 20px;

    .track-meta .track-badge {
      display: inline-block;

    .track-meta h4 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .track-meta p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;

    }

    /* Player Controls Right Side */
    .player-details {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .hifi-tag {
      display: inline-flex;

    .player-time {

    .controls-row {

      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .control-btn-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .control-icon-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .control-icon-btn:hover {
      color: #fff;
    }
    .play-trigger {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;

      color: #07030e;

      justify-content: center;

      transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;

    .play-trigger:hover {

      background: var(--teal-primary);

    .artist-tip-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;

    .artist-tip-bar span {
      color: #c4b5fd;

    .tip-action {

      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .tip-action:hover {
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    /* Proof / Metric Bar */
    .metrics-bar {
      padding: 40px 0 80px;
    }
    .metrics-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 840px) {
      .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; text-align: center; }
    }
    .metric-item h3 {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .metric-item p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* Features Section */
    .features-section {
      padding: 90px 0;
      position: relative;
    }
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 60px;
    }
    .section-tag {
      color: var(--teal-primary);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: block;
    }
    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }
    .section-header p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    /* Bento Grid */
    .bento-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .bento-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    .bento-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s, background 0.3s;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .bento-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(12, 218, 197, 0.3);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }
    .bento-card.col-span-2 {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .bento-card.col-span-2 { grid-column: span 1; }
    }
    .feature-icon-box {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      color: var(--teal-primary);
    }
    .feature-icon-box.teal {
      background: rgba(12, 218, 197, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(12, 218, 197, 0.25);
      color: var(--teal-primary);
    }
    .feature-icon-box svg {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
    }
    .bento-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .bento-card p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    /* Interactive Mini UI inside Bento */
    .artist-split-demo {
      margin-top: 24px;

      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-glass);

    .split-labels {
      display: flex;

      font-size: 0.8rem;
      margin-bottom: 8px;

      height: 10px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 99px;

      display: flex;

    .split-artist {
      width: 85%;

      border-radius: 99px 0 0 99px;

    .split-platform {
      width: 15%;

    /* Live Frequency Radar Visual */
    .radar-visual {
      margin-top: 20px;

    .cta-section {
      padding: 100px 0 120px;

    .cta-box {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 16, 56, 0.8) 0%, rgba(8, 28, 34, 0.8) 100%);

      content: '';

    .cta-box h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.5vw, 3.4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .cta-box p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
    }
    .cta-form {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      margin: 0 auto 20px;

    .cta-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);

      outline: none;

    .cta-footnote {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);

    /* Footer */
    footer {

      padding: 60px 0 40px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      background: rgba(4, 2, 8, 0.8);
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 50px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    .footer-brand p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-top: 14px;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .footer-col h5 {
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-col ul a {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .footer-col ul a:hover {
      color: var(--teal-primary);
    }
    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-top: 30px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; text-align: center; }
    }

    /* Sound wave interactive animation */
    .playing .wave-bar {
      animation: soundwave 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(2n) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(3n) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(4n) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(5n) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }

    @keyframes soundwave {
      0% { height: 6px; }
      100% { height: 38px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

            <div class="feature-icon-box">

            Zero MP3 Compression →

        <!-- Feature 3 -->
        <div class="bento-card">
          <div>
            <div class="feature-icon-box">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 2a14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0 20 14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0-20"/><path d="M2 12h20"/></svg>

          <div class="radar-visual">

              <div class="artist-avatar">KL</div>
              <div>
                <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;">Kyoto Lo-Fi Club</div>

              </div>
            </div>
            <span class="live-pulse-tag">● LIVE</span>

        <!-- Feature 4 -->

          <div>
            <div class="feature-icon-box teal">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>

            <span>Wavefront</span>
          </a>
          <p>The decentralized, high-fidelity streaming ecosystem engineered for independent musicians and passionate listeners.</p>

        <div class="footer-col">
          <h5>Platform</h5>
          <ul>

            <li><a href="#fidelity">FLAC Audio Engine</a></li>
            <li><a href="#discover">Curated Crates</a></li>
            <li><a href="#rooms">Spatial Rooms</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="footer-col">
          <h5>For Creators</h5>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#artists">Direct Payouts (85%)</a></li>
            <li><a href="#artists">Artist Portal</a></li>
            <li><a href="#artists">Distribute Music</a></li>
            <li><a href="#artists">Merch & Stems</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="footer-col">
          <h5>Company</h5>
          <ul>
            <li><a href="#manifesto">The Indie Manifesto</a></li>
            <li><a href="#privacy">Privacy & Data</a></li>
            <li><a href="#terms">Terms of Sound</a></li>
            <li><a href="https://twitter.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Twitter / X</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="footer-bottom">
        <div>© 2025 Wavefront Audio Inc. All rights reserved.</div>
        <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px;">
          <span>Engineered in 24-bit Precision</span>
          <span>•</span>
          <span style="color: var(--teal-primary);">All Indie. No Fillers.</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <!-- Interactive JavaScript logic -->
  <script>
    // Header Scroll Effect
    const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 40) {
        navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
    });

    // Interactive Demo Player Tracks
    const tracks = [
      {
        title: "Neon Nostalgia",
        artist: "Kora & The Velvet Echo",
        badge: "Featured Tape ✦ Exclusive"
      },
      {
        title: "Subterranean Bloom",
        artist: "Soma Drift",
        badge: "Ambient Dub ✦ Lossless 96kHz"
      },
      {
        title: "Static Reverie",
        artist: "Arlo & The Ghost Signals",
        badge: "Post-Punk Revival ✦ 24-Bit"
      }
    ];

    let currentTrackIdx = 0;
    let isPlaying = true;

    const trackTitle = document.getElementById('trackTitle');
    const artistName = document.getElementById('artistName');
    const playIcon = document.getElementById('playIcon');
    const vinylDisc = document.getElementById('vinylDisc');
    const waveform = document.getElementById('waveform');

    function updateTrackUI() {
      const track = tracks[currentTrackIdx];
      trackTitle.textContent = track.title;
      artistName.textContent = track.artist;
    }

    function togglePlay() {
      isPlaying = !isPlaying;
      if (isPlaying) {
        playIcon.innerHTML = '<rect x="6" y="4" width="4" height="16"/><rect x="14" y="4" width="4" height="16"/>';
        vinylDisc.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
        waveform.classList.add('playing');
      } else {
        playIcon.innerHTML = '<polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/>';
        vinylDisc.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
        waveform.classList.remove('playing');
      }
    }

    function cycleTrack(direction) {
      currentTrackIdx = (currentTrackIdx + direction + tracks.length) % tracks.length;
      updateTrackUI();
      if (!isPlaying) togglePlay();
    }

    function toggleLike(btn) {
      const svg = btn.querySelector('svg');
      if (svg.getAttribute('fill') === 'none') {
        svg.setAttribute('fill', '#0cdac5');
        svg.style.stroke = '#0cdac5';
      } else {
        svg.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
        svg.style.stroke = 'currentColor';
      }
    }

    // Set Initial Play State icon
    playIcon.innerHTML = '<rect x="6" y="4" width="4" height="16"/><rect x="14" y="4" width="4" height="16"/>';

    // Mock Form Submission
    function handleSignup(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('userEmail').value;
      alert(`Welcome to the revolution! An invitation frequency has been dispatched to ${email}`);
      document.getElementById('userEmail').value = '';
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design a modern, minimal landing page for a music streaming app called "Wavefront" that focuses on indie artists. The landing page should have a hero section, features section, and call-to-action. Use a color scheme of deep purples and teals. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Wavefront — Indie-First Streaming</title>
<meta name="description" content="Wavefront is the streaming home for independent artists. Fair splits, live rooms, zero payola.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --bg:#0a0613; --bg2:#110a20; --surface:#160d29; --surface2:#1c1133;
  --line:rgba(167,139,250,.15); --line-strong:rgba(167,139,250,.32);
  --purple:#7c3aed; --violet:#a78bfa; --violet-dim:rgba(167,139,250,.32);
  --teal:#2dd4bf; --teal-soft:#5eead4; --teal-deep:#0d9488;
  --ink:#f1ecfb; --muted:#a79bc4; --dim:#6f6490;
  --disp:'Unbounded',sans-serif; --body:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; --mono:'Space Mono',monospace;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink); font:400 16px/1.65 var(--body);
  overflow-x:hidden; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body.docked{padding-bottom:88px}
::selection{background:var(--teal);color:#04211d}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#2a1a4d;border-radius:5px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--purple)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font-family:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}

/* ============ OVERLAYS ============ */
.noise{position:fixed;inset:-50%;width:200%;height:200%;pointer-events:none;z-index:96;opacity:.055;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='180' height='180'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/></filter><rect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
  animation:grain 9s steps(6) infinite;}
@keyframes grain{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}20%{transform:translate(-2%,2%)}40%{transform:translate(2%,-1%)}60%{transform:translate(-1%,-2%)}80%{transform:translate(1%,2%)}}
#scrollProgress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:100%;z-index:110;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--violet));transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0)}

/* ============ NAV ============ */
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:90;transition:background .4s,border-color .4s;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(10,6,19,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-color:var(--line)}
.nav-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:72px;gap:20px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font:700 1.02rem var(--disp);letter-spacing:.06em}
.brand svg{flex:none}
.brand .wv{color:var(--teal)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:30px;font:500 .82rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em}
.nav-links a{color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s;position:relative;padding:4px 0}
.nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--teal);transition:width .3s var(--ease)}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%}
.nav-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}

/* ============ BUTTONS ============ */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font:600 .92rem var(--body);
  padding:.85rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s,background .25s,border-color .25s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-solid{background:var(--teal);color:#04211d}
.btn-solid:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 34px -10px rgba(45,212,191,.55)}
.btn-solid:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line-strong);color:var(--ink);background:rgba(167,139,250,.05)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--violet);background:rgba(167,139,250,.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-sm{padding:.55rem 1.05rem;font-size:.82rem}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:130px 0 90px;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:58px 58px;opacity:.5;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 65% at 50% 40%,#000 20%,transparent 75%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 65% at 50% 40%,#000 20%,transparent 75%)}
.hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(600px 420px at 82% 18%,rgba(45,212,191,.10),transparent 65%),
             radial-gradient(700px 520px at 12% 85%,rgba(124,58,237,.16),transparent 65%)}
.hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;width:100%}
.kicker{font:700 .68rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-transform:uppercase}
.kicker::before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--teal)}
.h1{font:700 clamp(2.1rem,4.9vw,3.9rem)/1.06 var(--disp);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:22px 0 24px}
.h1 .accent{color:var(--teal)}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.06rem;max-width:34rem}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:32px 0 40px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;list-style:none;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim)}
.stats li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.stats li+li::before{content:'◆';color:var(--purple);margin-right:14px;font-size:.5rem}
.stats b{color:var(--teal-soft);font-weight:700}
.side-label{position:absolute;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);writing-mode:vertical-rl;
  font:400 .62rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--dim);z-index:2}

/* --- player deck --- */
.hero-player{perspective:1100px}
.player{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(175deg,#1c1133,#120a22 70%);
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;
  box-shadow:0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7),0 0 0 1px rgba(45,212,191,.05) inset;
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease);transform-style:preserve-3d}
.player::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:10%;right:10%;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--teal),var(--purple),transparent)}
.corner{position:absolute;font:400 .9rem var(--mono);color:var(--violet-dim);line-height:1}
.corner.tl{top:8px;left:10px}.corner.br{bottom:8px;right:10px}
.p-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:20px}
.live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--teal)}
.live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);animation:pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(45,212,191,.5)}55%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(45,212,191,0)}}
.p-top{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.vinyl{position:relative;width:94px;height:94px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;
  animation:spin 7s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong),0 12px 26px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
body.playing .vinyl{animation-play-state:running}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.vinyl img{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.9)}
.vinyl::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,0,0,.32) 0 1px,transparent 1px 4px)}
.vinyl::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:37%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--teal)}
.p-meta{min-width:0}
.p-title{font:600 1.15rem var(--disp);letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.p-artist{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;margin-top:2px}
.p-genre{display:inline-block;margin-top:9px;font:700 .58rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--teal);
  border:1px solid rgba(45,212,191,.35);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px}
.p-wave{position:relative;height:96px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(10,6,19,.5);
  border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden}
.p-wave canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.p-times{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--dim);margin:12px 2px 18px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.p-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.c-btn{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  color:var(--muted);transition:all .25s var(--ease)}
.c-btn:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--violet);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.c-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.play-big{width:58px;height:58px;background:var(--teal);color:#04211d;border:none;
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px -8px rgba(45,212,191,.6)}
.play-big:hover{background:var(--teal-soft);color:#04211d;transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.04)}
.play-big svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.ic-pause{display:none}
body.playing .ic-pause{display:block}
body.playing .ic-play{display:none}
.p-extra{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:10px}
.chip-btn{font:700 .6rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);color:var(--muted);transition:all .25s}
.chip-btn:hover{color:var(--teal);border-color:rgba(45,212,191,.5)}
.chip-btn.loved{color:#f472b6;border-color:rgba(244,114,182,.5)}
.player-tag{margin-top:14px;text-align:right;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.26em;color:var(--dim)}

/* ============ MARQUEE ============ */
.marquee{overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0;position:relative}
.marquee+.marquee{border-top:none}
.mq-track{display:inline-flex;white-space:nowrap;animation:mq 30s linear infinite}
.marquee.rev .mq-track{animation-direction:reverse;animation-duration:38s}
.marquee:hover .mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.mq-track span{font:600 .82rem var(--disp);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-right:3rem;color:var(--violet)}
.mq-track span i{font-style:normal;color:var(--teal);padding-left:3rem}
.marquee.rev .mq-track span{color:var(--dim);font:700 .72rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.3em}

/* ============ SECTIONS COMMON ============ */
section{position:relative}
.sect{padding:118px 0}
.sect-head{margin-bottom:56px;max-width:760px}
.h2{font:700 clamp(1.55rem,3.3vw,2.5rem)/1.12 var(--disp);text-transform:uppercase;margin:20px 0 16px}
.sect-sub{color:var(--muted);max-width:36rem}
.lm{display:block;overflow:hidden}
.lm>span{display:block;transform:translateY(112%);transition:transform .9s var(--ease)}
.is-in .lm>span{transform:none}
.is-in .lm:nth-child(2)>span{transition-delay:.12s}
.is-in .lm:nth-child(3)>span{transition-delay:.24s}
[data-reveal]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .9s var(--ease)}
[data-reveal].is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ============ FEATURES ============ */
.features{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg2) 50%,var(--bg) 100%)}
.feat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:72px;align-items:start}
.feat-left{position:sticky;top:110px}
.feat-left .h2{margin-bottom:20px}
.feat-note{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:34px;max-width:26rem}
.feat-index{list-style:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.feat-index a{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;padding:13px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--dim);font-weight:500;transition:all .3s var(--ease)}
.feat-index a .mono{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.14em}
.feat-index li.active a, .feat-index a:hover{color:var(--ink);padding-left:14px}
.feat-index li.active a .mono{color:var(--teal)}
.paid-out{margin-top:30px;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim)}
.paid-out b{color:var(--teal-soft);font-size:.86rem;letter-spacing:.1em}
.f-block{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(22,13,41,.55);
  padding:34px 34px 38px;margin-bottom:26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .4s,transform .4s var(--ease)}
.f-block:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong);transform:translateX(6px)}
.f-block::after{content:attr(data-num);position:absolute;top:-14px;right:6px;font:800 6.4rem var(--disp);
  color:rgba(167,139,250,.06);pointer-events:none}
.f-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.f-num{font:700 .64rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--teal)}
.f-tag{margin-left:auto;font:700 .56rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--dim);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}
.f-block h3{font:600 1.18rem var(--disp);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em}
.f-block>p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem;max-width:34rem;margin-bottom:24px}
.f-widget{border:1px dashed var(--line-strong);border-radius:12px;padding:22px;background:rgba(10,6,19,.45)}

/* split bars */
.split-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr 46px;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:13px}
.split-row .lab{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--muted)}
.split-row .val{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink);text-align:right}
.bar{height:12px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(167,139,250,.1);overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--violet-dim);transition:width 1.4s var(--ease) .2s}
.bar i.teal{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal-deep),var(--teal))}
.f-block.in-view .bar i{width:var(--w)}
.cap{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--dim);margin-top:16px}

/* live room */
.room-head{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:16px}
.room-main{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}
.room-main img{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.room-main strong{font:600 1rem var(--disp);display:block}
.room-main .mono{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--dim)}
.room-main .btn{margin-left:auto}
.room-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:14px}
.avatars{display:flex}
.avatars img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--surface);margin-left:-8px}
.avatars img:first-child{margin-left:0}
.room-foot .mono{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted)}
.room-foot b{color:var(--teal-soft)}

/* taste graph */
.tg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.tg-line{stroke:rgba(167,139,250,.4);stroke-width:1;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:1;stroke-dashoffset:1;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.3s ease var(--d,0s)}
.f-block.in-view .tg-line{stroke-dashoffset:0}
.tg-node{fill:var(--violet);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.tg-node.t{fill:var(--teal)}
.tg-node.pulse{animation:nodepulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes nodepulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(1.7);opacity:.55}}
.tg text{font:700 7.5px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;fill:var(--dim)}
.tg text.hl{fill:var(--teal)}

/* receipt */
.receipt .r-head{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--teal);text-align:center;
  border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-strong);padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.r-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);padding:7px 0}
.r-total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink);
  border-top:1px dashed var(--line-strong);margin-top:10px;padding-top:12px}
.r-total b{color:var(--teal)}
.receipt .chip-btn{width:100%;margin-top:16px;text-align:center;display:block}

/* lossless spec */
.spec-toggle{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:18px}
.ab{font:700 .6rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.16em;padding:8px 16px;color:var(--dim);transition:all .3s}
.ab.active{background:var(--teal);color:#04211d}
.spec-read{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--teal-soft);margin-bottom:18px;min-height:1.2em}
.spec.mp3 .spec-read{color:var(--dim)}
.spec-bars{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:flex-end;height:52px}
.spec-bars i{flex:1;height:var(--h);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--teal),var(--teal-deep));border-radius:2px;transition:opacity .5s,background .5s}
.spec.mp3 .spec-bars i{background:var(--violet-dim)}
.spec.mp3 .spec-bars i:nth-child(3n){opacity:.25}
.spec.mp3 .spec-bars i:nth-child(4n){opacity:.4}

/* ============ SPOTLIGHT ============ */
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:26px;padding:20px 0 10px}
.postcard{--r:0deg;position:relative;background:#171029;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;
  padding:13px 13px 18px;transform:rotate(var(--r)) translateY(var(--y,0));
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s,border-color .5s}
.postcard:hover{transform:rotate(0) translateY(calc(var(--y,0px) - 12px)) scale(1.02);
  box-shadow:0 34px 70px -22px rgba(124,58,237,.45);border-color:rgba(45,212,191,.45);z-index:3}
.postcard::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-11px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-2.5deg);
  width:86px;height:22px;background:rgba(45,212,191,.22);border:1px solid rgba(45,212,191,.15);border-radius:2px}
.pc-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px;aspect-ratio:4/5}
.pc-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.88) contrast(1.06);
  transition:transform 1.4s var(--ease)}
.postcard:hover .pc-img img{transform:scale(1.09)}
.pc-play{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--teal);color:#04211d;display:grid;place-items:center;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:all .35s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -6px rgba(45,212,191,.6)}
.postcard:hover .pc-play,.pc-play.current{opacity:1;transform:none}
.pc-play svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.pc-name{font:600 1rem var(--disp);margin:15px 2px 3px;text-transform:uppercase}
.pc-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font:400 .6rem var(--mono);
  letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);padding:0 2px}
.pc-row .g{color:var(--teal)}
.pc-quote{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;margin:10px 2px 0;line-height:1.5}

/* ============ CHARTS ============ */
.charts{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.chart{list-style:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.crow{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.6rem 2.2rem 44px 1fr 10rem 7rem 4.4rem;gap:18px;align-items:center;
  padding:14px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:left;border-radius:0;
  transition:background .3s,transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s;position:relative}
.crow:hover{background:rgba(167,139,250,.07);transform:translateX(6px)}
.crow.current{background:rgba(45,212,191,.06);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--teal)}
.c-rank{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--dim)}
.crow.current .c-rank{color:var(--teal)}
.eq{display:inline-flex;gap:2.5px;align-items:flex-end;height:16px}
.eq i{width:3px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--violet-dim);height:35%}
.eq i:nth-child(2){height:80%}.eq i:nth-child(3){height:55%}.eq i:nth-child(4){height:95%}
body.playing .crow.current .eq i,body.playing .d-eq i{background:var(--teal);animation:eqb 1s ease-in-out infinite}
body.playing .crow.current .eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
body.playing .crow.current .eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
body.playing .crow.current .eq i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.45s}
body.playing .d-eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}
body.playing .d-eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.35s}
body.playing .d-eq i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.5s}
@keyframes eqb{0%,100%{height:25%}50%{height:100%}}
.c-art{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.c-title b{font:600 .95rem var(--disp);display:block;letter-spacing:.01em}
.c-title em{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);font-size:.84rem}
.c-genre{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--dim)}
.c-plays{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--teal-soft);letter-spacing:.06em}
.c-dur{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--dim);text-align:right}
.chart-foot{margin-top:22px;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim)}

/* ============ CTA ============ */
.cta{padding:130px 0}
.cta-panel{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(800px 400px at 15% 0%,rgba(124,58,237,.22),transparent 60%),
             radial-gradient(600px 380px at 90% 110%,rgba(13,148,136,.2),transparent 60%),var(--surface);
  padding:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,4.2rem)}
.cta-panel .corner{font-size:1.1rem}
.cta-waves{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:.22;pointer-events:none}
.wg{animation:drift 16s linear infinite}
.wg.w2{animation-duration:23s;animation-direction:reverse}
.wg.w3{animation-duration:31s}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translateX(-1200px)}}
.cta-grid{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.cta-list{list-style:none;margin-top:26px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.cta-list li{font:700 .64rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted)}
.cta-list li::before{content:'✦ ';color:var(--teal)}
.cta-form{background:rgba(10,6,19,.6);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:16px;padding:28px}
.cf-label{font:700 .6rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:16px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px}
.chip{flex:1;font:700 .66rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);color:var(--dim);transition:all .3s}
.chip.active{background:rgba(45,212,191,.12);border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal)}
.cf-input{width:100%;background:rgba(22,13,41,.8);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:10px;
  padding:14px 16px;color:var(--ink);font:500 .92rem var(--body);margin-bottom:14px;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.cf-input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
.cf-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,.15)}
.cf-input.shake{animation:shake .4s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:none}25%{transform:translateX(-6px)}75%{transform:translateX(6px)}}
.cta-form .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
.cf-note{margin-top:14px;font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--dim);text-align:center}
.cf-success{text-align:center;padding:26px 0}
.cf-success .big{font:700 2.6rem var(--disp);color:var(--teal)}
.cf-success p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;font-size:.94rem}

/* ============ FOOTER ============ */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:70px 0 34px;overflow:hidden}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr repeat(4,1fr);gap:36px;margin-bottom:70px}
.foot-brand p{color:var(--dim);font-size:.86rem;max-width:16rem;margin-top:14px}
.foot-col h4{font:700 .62rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:18px}
.foot-col a{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;padding:5px 0;transition:color .25s,transform .25s var(--ease)}
.foot-col a:hover{color:var(--ink);transform:translateX(4px)}
.foot-word{font:800 clamp(3rem,12.5vw,10.5rem)/1 var(--disp);letter-spacing:.02em;text-align:center;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(167,139,250,.3);user-select:none;
  transition:color .8s,-webkit-text-stroke .8s;margin-bottom:40px;text-transform:uppercase}
.foot-word:hover{color:rgba(45,212,191,.14);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(45,212,191,.55)}
.foot-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:26px;font:400 .6rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--dim)}
.status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--teal)}

/* ============ DOCK ============ */
.dock{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:95;background:rgba(15,8,28,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong);transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .55s var(--ease)}
.dock.show{transform:none}
.dock-prog{position:absolute;top:-2px;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:rgba(167,139,250,.15);cursor:pointer}
.dock-prog i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal-deep),var(--teal));transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0)}
.dock-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:74px}
.dock-in img{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.d-meta{min-width:0}
.d-meta b{font:600 .86rem var(--disp);display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.d-meta span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem}
.d-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-left:auto}
.d-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);transition:all .25s}
.d-btn:hover{color:var(--ink);background:rgba(167,139,250,.12)}
.d-btn svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.d-play{width:44px;height:44px;background:var(--teal);color:#04211d}
.d-play:hover{background:var(--teal-soft)}
.d-play svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.d-time{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.08em}

/* ============ TOAST ============ */
.toast{position:fixed;left:24px;bottom:104px;z-index:120;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--teal);
  color:var(--ink);font:700 .72rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:0 20px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7);opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .35s,transform .35s var(--ease)}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media(max-width:1080px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:44px}
  .hero{padding-top:118px}
  .side-label{display:none}
  .feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:44px}
  .feat-left{position:static}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .cta-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}
  .foot-brand{grid-column:1/-1}
}
@media(max-width:860px){.nav-links{display:none}}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .crow{grid-template-columns:2rem 1.8rem 40px 1fr 3.6rem}
  .c-genre,.c-plays{display:none}
  .c-art{width:40px;height:40px}
  .d-time{display:none}
  .sect{padding:86px 0}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .postcard{--y:0!important}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .hero-ctas .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .p-extra{display:none}
}

/* ============ REDUCED MOTION ============ */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  [data-reveal]{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .lm>span{transform:none}
  .f-block.in-view .bar i{width:var(--w)}
  .tg-line{stroke-dashoffset:0}
  .pc-play{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
</style>

        <svg class="ic-play" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M3.5 1.5v13L14 8z"/></svg>
        <svg class="ic-pause" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M3 2h3.6v12H3zM9.4 2H13v12H9.4z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="d-btn" id="dNext" aria-label="Next track"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M11 2h2v12h-2zM2 2v12l8.5-6z"/></svg></button>

  </div>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const RM=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/* ---------- data ---------- */
const TRACKS=[
 {title:"Neon Cathedral",artist:"Velvet Static",genre:"DREAM POP",dur:214,plays:"1.28M",seed:"wavefront-velvet-static"},
 {title:"Glasshouse",artist:"Mira Vale",genre:"BEDROOM SOUL",dur:187,plays:"986K",seed:"wavefront-mira-vale"},
 {title:"Motorik Heart",artist:"Cassette Bloom",genre:"KRAUT INDIE",dur:243,plays:"741K",seed:"wavefront-cassette-bloom"},
 {title:"Low Tide FM",artist:"The Harbor Lights",genre:"SURF GOTH",dur:198,plays:"693K",seed:"wavefront-harbor-lights"},
 {title:"Sodium Lights",artist:"Foxglove Ave",genre:"SLOWCORE",dur:226,plays:"512K",seed:"wavefront-foxglove-ave"},
 {title:"Dial Tone Love",artist:"Juniper Static",genre:"SHOEGAZE",dur:172,plays:"448K",seed:"wavefront-juniper-static"}
];
const fmt=s=>Math.floor(s/60)+":"+String(Math.floor(s%60)).padStart(2,"0");
function mulberry(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}

/* ---------- toast ---------- */
let tt;const toastEl=$('#toast');
function toast(msg){toastEl.textContent=msg;toastEl.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>toastEl.classList.remove('show'),2400)}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-toast]');if(t)toast(t.dataset.toast)});

/* ---------- scroll progress + nav ---------- */
const prog=$('#scrollProgress'),nav=$('#nav');
addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  const h=document.documentElement, p=h.scrollTop/(h.scrollHeight-h.clientHeight||1);
  prog.style.transform=`scaleX(${p})`;
  nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',h.scrollTop>40);
},{passive:true});

/* ---------- reveal observer ---------- */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{
  if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('is-in');io.unobserve(en.target)}
}),{threshold:.16});
$$('[data-reveal],.sect-head,.f-block').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

/* ---------- scramble decode ---------- */
function scramble(el,dur=950){
  const final=el.dataset.text||el.textContent;el.dataset.text=final;
  if(RM){el.textContent=final;return}
  const glyphs='▓▒░<>/\\|=+*#%&';const start=performance.now();
  (function tick(now){
    const p=Math.min(1,(now-start)/dur),reveal=Math.floor(p*final.length);
    let out=final.slice(0,reveal);
    for(let i=reveal;i<final.length;i++)out+=final[i]===' '?' ':glyphs[(Math.random()*glyphs.length)|0];
    el.textContent=out;
    if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else el.textContent=final;
  })(start);
}
addEventListener('load',()=>{$$('[data-scramble]').forEach((el,i)=>setTimeout(()=>scramble(el),250+i*480))});

/* ---------- hero tilt ---------- */
const hero=$('.hero'),player=$('#player');
if(!RM&&matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
  hero.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
    const r=hero.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;
    player.style.transform=`rotateY(${x*4}deg) rotateX(${-y*3.5}deg)`;
  });
  hero.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>player.style.transform='');
}

/* ---------- player core ---------- */
const state={i:0,t:0,dur:TRACKS[0].dur,playing:false,hover:-1,bars:[],started:false};
const wave=$('#wave'),ctx=wave.getContext('2d'),pWave=$('#pWave');
const cv={W:0,H:0};
function sizeWave(){
  const r=pWave.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1);
  wave.width=r.width*d;wave.height=r.height*d;ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);
  cv.W=r.width;cv.H=r.height;
}
new ResizeObserver(sizeWave).observe(pWave);sizeWave();

function genBars(i){
  const rnd=mulberry(1234+i*777),n=110,out=[];
  for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
    const env=.5+.5*Math.sin(k/n*Math.PI),beat=.55+.45*Math.sin(k*.9+i*3);
    out.push(Math.min(1,Math.max(.09,env*(.35+.65*rnd())*beat)));
  }
  return out;
}
function drawWave(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.W,cv.H);
  const n=state.bars.length;if(!n)return;
  const bw=cv.W/n,prog=state.dur?state.t/state.dur:0,mid=cv.H/2;
  for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
    const h=Math.max(3,state.bars[k]*cv.H*.88),x=k*bw+bw*.2,w=bw*.6;
    ctx.fillStyle=(k+.5)/n<=prog?'#2dd4bf':'rgba(167,139,250,.30)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(ctx.roundRect)ctx.roundRect(x,mid-h/2,w,h,w/2);else ctx.rect(x,mid-h/2,w,h);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(94,234,212,.95)';ctx.fillRect(prog*cv.W-1,mid-cv.H*.47,2,cv.H*.94);
  if(state.hover>=0){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(241,236,251,.28)';ctx.fillRect(state.hover*cv.W,mid-cv.H*.47,1,cv.H*.94)}
}

const rows=[];
function buildChart(){
  const list=$('#chartList');
  TRACKS.forEach((tr,i)=>{
    const li=document.createElement('li');
    li.innerHTML=`<button class="crow" data-i="${i}">
      <span class="c-rank mono">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span>
      <span class="eq" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>
      <img class="c-art" src="https://picsum.photos/seed/${tr.seed}/88/88" alt="" loading="lazy">
      <span class="c-title"><b>${tr.title}</b><em>${tr.artist}</em></span>
      <span class="c-genre mono">${tr.genre}</span>
      <span class="c-plays mono">▲ ${tr.plays}</span>
      <span class="c-dur mono">${fmt(tr.dur)}</span></button>`;
    list.appendChild(li);rows.push(li.firstElementChild);
    rows[i].addEventListener('click',()=>loadTrack(i,true));
  });
}
buildChart();

function syncUI(){
  document.body.classList.toggle('playing',state.playing);
  $$('.play-btn').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',state.playing));
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>r.classList.toggle('current',i===state.i));
  $$('.pc-play').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('current',+b.dataset.i===state.i&&state.started));
  if(state.started){$('#dock').classList.add('show');document.body.classList.add('docked');$('#dock').setAttribute('aria-hidden','false')}
}
function loadTrack(i,play){
  const tr=TRACKS[i];
  state.i=i;state.dur=tr.dur;state.t=0;state.bars=genBars(i);
  $('#pTitle').textContent=tr.title;$('#pArtist').textContent=tr.artist;$('#pGenre').textContent=tr.genre;
  $('#pDur').textContent=fmt(tr.dur);$('#dDur').textContent=fmt(tr.dur);
  $('#pArt').src=`https://picsum.photos/seed/${tr.seed}/200/200`;
  $('#dArt').src=`https://picsum.photos/seed/${tr.seed}/92/92`;
  $('#dTitle').textContent=tr.title;$('#dArtist').textContent=tr.artist;
  state.playing=!!play;if(play)state.started=true;
  syncUI();
}
function togglePlay(){
  if(!state.started){state.started=true}
  state.playing=!state.playing;syncUI();
  if(state.playing)toast('▶ Now playing — '+TRACKS[state.i].title);
}
const next=()=>loadTrack((state.i+1)%TRACKS.length,true);
const prev=()=>state.t>4?(state.t=0):loadTrack((state.i-1+TRACKS.length)%TRACKS.length,true);
$('#btnPlay').addEventListener('click',togglePlay);
$('#dPlay').addEventListener('click',togglePlay);
$('#btnNext').addEventListener('click',next);$('#dNext').addEventListener('click',next);
$('#btnPrev').addEventListener('click',prev);$('#dPrev').addEventListener('click',prev);
$('#heroPlay').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!state.playing)togglePlay()});
$('#navPlay').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!state.playing)togglePlay();$('#player').scrollIntoView({behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth',block:'center'})});
$$('.play-track').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>loadTrack(+b.dataset.i,true)));

addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.code==='Space'&&!/INPUT|TEXTAREA|BUTTON/.test(e.target.tagName)){e.preventDefault();togglePlay()}
});

/* seek */
pWave.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=pWave.getBoundingClientRect();state.hover=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width))});
pWave.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>state.hover=-1);
pWave.addEventListener('click',e=>{const r=pWave.getBoundingClientRect();state.t=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*state.dur});
$('#dockProg').addEventListener('click',e=>{const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();state.t=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*state.dur;if(!state.started){state.started=true;syncUI()}});

/* heart + tip */
$('#btnHeart').addEventListener('click',function(){
  this.classList.toggle('loved');
  this.textContent=this.classList.contains('loved')?'♥ SAVED':'♡ SAVE';
  toast(this.classList.contains('loved')?'Saved to your library ✦':'Removed from library');
});
$('#btnTip').addEventListener('click',()=>toast('♥ $3 tip sent to '+TRACKS[state.i].artist));

/* main loop */
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt=(now-last)/1000;last=now;
  if(state.playing){
    state.t+=dt;
    if(state.t>=state.dur)next();
    $('#pCur').textContent=fmt(state.t);$('#dCur').textContent=fmt(state.t);
    $('#dockBar').style.transform=`scaleX(${state.t/state.dur})`;
  }
  drawWave();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
state.bars=genBars(0);requestAnimationFrame(loop);

/* ---------- feature index active ---------- */
const idxLis=$$('#featIndex li');
const fio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{
  if(en.isIntersecting){
    idxLis.forEach(li=>li.classList.toggle('active',li.dataset.for===en.target.id));
  }
}),{rootMargin:'-40% 0px -50% 0px'});
$$('.f-block').forEach(b=>fio.observe(b));

/* ---------- live counters ---------- */
let roomN=1204,paid=11406212;
const cio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
  es.forEach(en=>{
    if(!en.isIntersecting||RM)return;
    if(en.target.id==='f02'&&!en.target._iv){
      en.target._iv=setInterval(()=>{roomN+=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);$('#roomCount').textContent=roomN.toLocaleString()},2200);
    }
  });
},{threshold:.4});
const f02=$('#f02');if(f02)cio.observe(f02);
if(!RM){
  const pio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{es.forEach(en=>{
    if(en.isIntersecting&&!en.target._iv){
      en.target._iv=setInterval(()=>{paid+=3+Math.floor(Math.random()*38);$('#paidOut').textContent='$'+paid.toLocaleString()},1600);
    }
  })},{threshold:.4});
  pio.observe($('#paidOut'));
}

/* ---------- lossless AB toggle ---------- */
$$('.ab').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $$('.ab').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));b.classList.add('active');
  const mp3=b.dataset.mode==='mp3';
  $('#spec').classList.toggle('mp3',mp3);
  $('#specRead').textContent=mp3?'320 kbps OGG — DSP-NORMALIZED · DETAIL SHELVED':'24-BIT / 96 kHz FLAC — MASTER AS DELIVERED';
}));

/* ---------- CTA form ---------- */
let role='listener';
$$('.chip').forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  $$('.chip').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));c.classList.add('active');
  role=c.dataset.role;
  $('#ctaSubmit').textContent=role==='artist'?'Claim my artist page':'Get early access';
}));
$('#ctaForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const inp=$('#ctaEmail');
  if(!/.+@.+\..+/.test(inp.value)){
    inp.classList.remove('shake');void inp.offsetWidth;inp.classList.add('shake');
    toast('Enter a valid email to tune in');inp.focus();return;
  }
  e.target.innerHTML=`<div class="cf-success"><div class="big">✦</div>
    <p><strong>You're on the front line.</strong><br>${role==='artist'?'Your artist page invite lands this week — keep your masters ready.':'Your invite drops soon. First month of Plus is on us.'}</p></div>`;
  toast(role==='artist'?'Artist invite requested ✦':'Early access secured ✦');
});
})();
</script>
