            justify-content: center;
            margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .feature-icon.teal {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2), rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);
        }

        .feature-icon.purple {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2);
        }

        .feature-icon svg {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
        }

        .feature-title {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .feature-description {
            color: var(--gray-300);
            font-size: 0.975rem;
            line-height: 1.75;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* ===== HOW IT WORKS ===== */
        .how-it-works {
            position: relative;
        }

        .how-it-works::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 80%;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2), transparent);
        }

        .steps {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 3rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .steps::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 42px;
            left: 16.6%;
            right: 16.6%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal-dark), var(--purple-light), var(--teal-dark));
            opacity: 0.3;
        }

        .step {
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .step-number {
            width: 84px;
            height: 84px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin: 0 auto 2rem;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.65rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            position: relative;
        }

        .step:nth-child(1) .step-number {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-dark), var(--teal-mid));
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
        }

        .step:nth-child(2) .step-number {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-mid), var(--purple-light));
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);
        }

        .step:nth-child(3) .step-number {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-mid));
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.3);
        }

        .step-title {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .step-description {
            color: var(--gray-300);
            font-size: 0.975rem;
            line-height: 1.75;
            max-width: 300px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        /* ===== ARTIST SPOTLIGHT ===== */
        .artist-spotlight {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .artist-spotlight::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08), transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 50%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08), transparent 50%);
        }

        .spotlight-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 1.75rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .artist-card {
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .artist-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25);
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }

        .artist-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 220px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .artist-image-bg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.5s ease;
        }

        .artist-card:hover .artist-image-bg {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .artist-image-bg.a1 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e, #16213e, #0f3460);
        }

        .artist-image-bg.a2 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d1b69, #1a0a3e, #5b21b6);
        }

        .artist-image-bg.a3 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0e7490, #134e4a, #065f46);
        }

        .artist-image-bg.a4 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #4c1d95, #2d1b69);
        }

        .artist-avatar-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .artist-avatar {
            width: 70px;
            height: 70px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .artist-info {
            padding: 1.5rem;
        }

        .artist-name {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
        }

        .artist-genre {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--teal-light);
            margin-bottom: 1.15rem;
        }

        .artist-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .artist-stat {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        .artist-stat strong {
            color: var(--white);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
        .testimonials {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--purple-deep), rgba(30, 15, 75, 0.6), var(--purple-deep));
        }

        .testimonial-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1.75rem;
        }

        .testimonial-card {
            padding: 2.5rem;
            border-radius: 22px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .testimonial-card:hover {
            border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }

        .testimonial-stars {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.25rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .star {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            color: var(--teal-bright);
        }

        .testimonial-text {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--gray-300);
            margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .testimonial-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .testimonial-avatar {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        .testimonial-avatar.t1 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-dark), var(--teal-mid));
        }

        .testimonial-avatar.t2 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-mid), var(--purple-light));
        }

        .testimonial-avatar.t3 {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--purple-mid));
        }

        .testimonial-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        .testimonial-role {
            font-size: 0.825rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        /* ===== PRICING ===== */
        .pricing-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1.75rem;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .pricing-card {
            padding: 2.75rem 2.25rem;
            border-radius: 24px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        .pricing-card:hover {
            border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15);
            transform: translateY(-4px);
        }

        .pricing-card.featured {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.15), rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1));
            border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(91, 33, 182, 0.15);
            transform: scale(1.04);
        }

        .pricing-card.featured:hover {
            transform: scale(1.04) translateY(-4px);
        }

        .pricing-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-bright));
            color: white;
            font-size: 0.775rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .pricing-name {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .pricing-price {
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .pricing-price .amount {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 3.25rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .pricing-price .period {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        .pricing-desc {
            font-size: 0.925rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
            margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
        }

        .pricing-features {
            list-style: none;
            text-align: left;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .pricing-features li {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            font-size: 0.925rem;
            color: var(--gray-300);
        }

        .check-icon {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .check-icon.teal {
            background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15);
            color: var(--teal-bright);
        }

        .check-icon.purple {
            background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15);
            color: var(--purple-light);
        }

        /* ===== CTA SECTION ===== */
        .cta-section {
            padding: 6rem 0 8rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .cta-container {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 2.5rem;
        }

        .cta-box {
            border-radius: 32px;
            padding: 5rem 4rem;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-dark), var(--purple-mid), var(--teal-dark));
        }

        .cta-box::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 15% 30%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25), transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 85% 70%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25), transparent 50%);
        }

        .cta-pattern {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 40px 40px;
        }

        .cta-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .cta-title {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .cta-description {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
            max-width: 580px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
            line-height: 1.75;
        }

        .cta-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1.25rem;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
        }

        .cta-note {
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
        }

        .cta-note a {
            color: var(--teal-light);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
        footer {
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            padding: 5rem 0 2.5rem;
        }

        .footer-container {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 2.5rem;
        }

        .footer-top {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 3rem;
            margin-bottom: 4rem;
        }

        .footer-brand {
            max-width: 280px;
        }

        .footer-brand .logo {
            margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
        }

        .footer-brand-desc {
            font-size: 0.925rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
            line-height: 1.75;
            margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
        }

        .social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.85rem;
        }

        .social-link {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            color: var(--gray-500);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .social-link:hover {
            background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1);
            border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25);
            color: var(--teal-bright);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .social-link svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            fill: currentColor;
        }

        .footer-column h4 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.925rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .footer-column ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.85rem;
        }

        .footer-column a {
            color: var(--gray-500);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.885rem;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .footer-column a:hover {
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        .footer-bottom {
            padding-top: 2.5rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .footer-copyright {
            font-size: 0.855rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        .footer-legal {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
        }

        .footer-legal a {
            font-size: 0.855rem;
            color: var(--gray-500);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .footer-legal a:hover {
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(30px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes fadeInRight {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateX(40px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            transition: all 0.8s ease;
        }

        .reveal.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .hero-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                text-align: center;
                gap: 3rem;
            }

            .hero-content {
                max-width: 100%;
                margin: 0 auto;
            }

            .hero-description {
                max-width: 100%;
            }

            .hero-actions {
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .hero-stats {
                justify-content: center;
            }

            .hero-visual {
                display: none;
            }

            .hero-title {
                font-size: 3.5rem;
            }

            .features-grid,
            .testimonial-grid,
            .pricing-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .pricing-card.featured {
                transform: scale(1);
            }

            .pricing-card.featured:hover {
                transform: translateY(-4px);
            }

            .spotlight-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .footer-top {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .steps {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 2.5rem;
            }

            .steps::before {
                display: none;
            }

            .section-title {
                font-size: 2.75rem;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .nav-links {
                display: none;
            }

            .hero {
                padding: 7rem 0 3rem;
            }

            .hero-title {
                font-size: 2.75rem;
            }

            .hero-stats {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                gap: 1.5rem;
            }

            .stat-divider {
                display: none;
            }

            .features-grid,
            .testimonial-grid,
            .pricing-grid,
            .spotlight-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .section {
                padding: 5rem 0;
            }

            .section-title {
                font-size: 2.25rem;
            }

            .cta-box {
                padding: 3.5rem 2rem;
            }

            .cta-title {
                font-size: 2.5rem;
            }

            .cta-actions {
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            .footer-top {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 2.5rem;
            }

            .footer-bottom {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 1.25rem;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .hero-actions {
                flex-direction: column;
                width: 100%;
            }

            .hero-actions .btn {
                width: 100%;
            }
        }

        /* ===== PARTICLES ===== */
        .particle {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .particle-1 {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--teal-bright);
            opacity: 0.3;
            top: 20%;
            left: 10%;
            animation: particle-float 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .particle-2 {
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--purple-light);
            opacity: 0.4;
            top: 60%;
            left: 85%;
            animation: particle-float 10s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
        }

        .particle-3 {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--teal-light);
            opacity: 0.2;
            top: 40%;
            left: 50%;
            animation: particle-float 12s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes particle-float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            25% { transform: translate(20px, -30px); }
            50% { transform: translate(-15px, -60px); }
            75% { transform: translate(10px, -30px); }
        }

        /* Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--purple-deep);
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--purple-dark);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: var(--purple-mid);
        }

        /* Selection */
        ::selection {
            background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
            color: white;
        }
    </style>
</head>

        // Navbar scroll effect
        const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 50) {
                navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
            } else {
                navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
            }
        });

        // Reveal on scroll
        const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');

        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, index * 100);
                    revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        });

        revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

        // Smooth scroll for anchor links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                const href = this.getAttribute('href');
                if (href === '#') return;

                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(href);
                if (target) {
                    const offset = 80;
                    const position = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - offset;
                    window.scrollTo({ top: position, behavior: 'smooth' });
                }
            });
        });

        // Equalizer bars randomization
        const eqBars = document.querySelectorAll('.eq-bar');
        function randomizeEq() {
            eqBars.forEach(bar => {
                const randomHeight = Math.random() * 100;
                bar.style.height = `${Math.max(25, randomHeight)}%`;
            });
        }
        setInterval(randomizeEq, 300);
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Wavefront — Discover Indie Music</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --deep-purple: #1a0a2e;
            --purple-mid: #2d1b69;
            --purple-light: #5b3cc4;
            --teal-dark: #0d4f4f;
            --teal-mid: #1a8a8a;
            --teal-light: #2ec4c4;
            --teal-glow: #5ff5e8;
            --white: #f0eeff;
            --gray: #a8a3c0;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--deep-purple);
            color: var(--white);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* ── NAV ── */
        nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 1.25rem 3rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            background: rgba(26, 10, 46, 0.6);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(91, 60, 196, 0.15);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .logo-icon svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .logo-text {
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light), var(--teal-glow));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2.5rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--gray);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -4px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-glow));
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .nav-cta {
            padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-light));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            color: var(--deep-purple);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .nav-cta:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(46, 196, 196, 0.35);
        }

        /* ── HERO ── */
        .hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            padding: 8rem 3rem 4rem;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-bg .orb {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(100px);
            opacity: 0.5;
            animation: float 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .orb-1 {
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--purple-mid), transparent);
            top: -10%;
            right: -5%;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }

        .orb-2 {
            width: 500px;
            height: 500px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--teal-dark), transparent);
            bottom: -15%;
            left: -10%;
            animation-delay: -3s;
        }

        .orb-3 {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--purple-light), transparent);
            top: 40%;
            left: 50%;
            animation-delay: -5s;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
            33% { transform: translate(30px, -30px) scale(1.05); }
            66% { transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(0.95); }
        }

        .hero-grid {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(91, 60, 196, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(91, 60, 196, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 30%, transparent 70%);
            -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 30%, transparent 70%);
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 900px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
            background: rgba(91, 60, 196, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(91, 60, 196, 0.25);
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--teal-light);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
        }

        .badge-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--teal-glow);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.5); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -2px;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.15s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .hero h1 .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light) 0%, var(--teal-glow) 50%, var(--purple-light) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
            color: var(--gray);
            max-width: 580px;
            margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.7;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.3s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.45s forwards;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 1rem 2.2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-mid), var(--teal-light));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 60px;
            color: var(--deep-purple);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn-primary::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light), var(--teal-glow));
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .btn-primary span {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(46, 196, 196, 0.3);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(168, 163, 192, 0.3);
            border-radius: 60px;
            color: var(--white);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--teal-light);
            background: rgba(46, 196, 196, 0.08);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .play-icon {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
        }

        .hero-wave {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .hero-wave svg {

        }

        /* ── EQUALIZER ANIMATION ── */
        .equalizer {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 3px;
            height: 24px;
        }

        .eq-bar {
            width: 4px;
            background: var(--teal-glow);

        .eq-bar:nth-child(1) { height: 8px; animation-delay: 0s; }
        .eq-bar:nth-child(2) { height: 16px; animation-delay: 0.15s; }
        .eq-bar:nth-child(3) { height: 10px; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .eq-bar:nth-child(4) { height: 20px; animation-delay: 0.45s; }
        .eq-bar:nth-child(5) { height: 6px; animation-delay: 0.6s; }

        @keyframes eqBounce {

        /* ── STATS BAR ── */

                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, index * 100);
                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --void:#080314;
  --deep:#10062a;
  --plum:#180a34;
  --raise:#22103f;
  --raise2:#2c1450;
  --violet:#8b5cf6;
  --violet-dim:#6b3fd0;
  --teal:#19e3c8;
  --teal-deep:#0d9f92;
  --cream:#f0e9ff;
  --muted:#a491c8;
  --muted2:#7a67a0;
  --edge:rgba(160,120,220,.18);
  --edge-strong:rgba(180,140,240,.34);
  --display:'Syne',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --body:'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --pad:clamp(20px,5vw,64px);
  --maxw:1280px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;background:var(--void);color:var(--cream);
  font-family:var(--body);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(15px,.55vw + 13px,17px);line-height:1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;
}
body::after{ /* grain */
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;opacity:.055;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.8' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/></filter><rect width='160' height='160' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0}
::selection{background:var(--teal);color:#04120f}

.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding-inline:var(--pad)}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.teal{color:var(--teal)}

/* ============ SCROLL PROGRESS ============ */
#progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:100%;z-index:150;background:transparent}
#progress span{display:block;height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--violet),var(--teal));box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(25,227,200,.6)}

/* ============ TICKER ============ */
.ticker{position:relative;z-index:60;background:var(--deep);border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);overflow:hidden;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.ticker-tag{flex:none;z-index:2;padding:0 14px;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--teal);color:#05130f;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500}
.ticker-tag i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#05130f;animation:blip 1.2s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes blip{50%{opacity:.15}}
.ticker-track{display:flex;white-space:nowrap;animation:slide 42s linear infinite;will-change:transform}
.ticker-track>div{display:flex;gap:34px;padding-left:34px}
.ticker b{font-weight:500;color:var(--cream)}
.ticker em{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted2)}
.ticker s{text-decoration:none;color:var(--teal);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ============ NAV ============ */
header.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:120;background:rgba(8,3,20,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color .4s,background .4s}
header.nav.stuck{border-bottom-color:var(--edge);background:rgba(11,4,26,.92)}
.nav-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;height:74px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.brand-mark{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2.5px;height:20px}
.brand-mark i{width:3px;background:var(--teal);border-radius:1px;animation:bounce 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
.brand-mark i:nth-child(1){height:9px;animation-delay:-.2s}
.brand-mark i:nth-child(2){height:18px;background:var(--violet);animation-delay:-.5s}
.brand-mark i:nth-child(3){height:12px;animation-delay:-.8s}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.45)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:30px}
.nav-links a{font-size:.86rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);position:relative;padding:4px 0;transition:color .3s}
.nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:1px;width:0;background:var(--teal);transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.nav-links a:hover,.nav-links a.active{color:var(--cream)}
.nav-links a:hover::after,.nav-links a.active::after{width:100%}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:2px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .25s,background .25s,color .25s}
.btn-solid{background:var(--teal);color:#05130f;font-weight:500}
.btn-solid:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 26px -8px rgba(25,227,200,.65)}
.btn-ghost{border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);color:var(--cream)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
@media(max-width:900px){.nav-links{display:none}}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{position:relative;background:
  radial-gradient(900px 420px at 78% 8%,rgba(139,92,246,.3),transparent 70%),
  radial-gradient(700px 380px at 8% 92%,rgba(25,227,200,.14),transparent 70%),
  var(--deep);
  padding:clamp(48px,7vw,92px) 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:clamp(28px,4vw,64px);align-items:start;position:relative;z-index:3}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:26px}
.eyebrow::before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--teal)}
h1.mega{font-size:clamp(2.9rem,7.4vw,6.1rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:.92}
.mask{display:block;overflow:hidden}
.mask>span{display:block;transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.in .mask>span,.mask.in>span{transform:none}
h1.mega .thin{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:300;font-style:normal;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h1.mega .out{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.4px var(--violet)}
.lede{max-width:44ch;color:var(--muted);margin:26px 0 34px;font-size:1.04rem}
.lede b{color:var(--cream);font-weight:600}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.hero-note{display:flex;gap:22px;margin-top:34px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-note div{border-left:1px solid var(--edge-strong);padding-left:14px}
.hero-note strong{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.hero-note span{color:var(--muted2);font-size:.76rem}

/* player card */
.player{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(165deg,var(--raise2),var(--plum));border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);padding:18px;box-shadow:0 40px 90px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 0 0 1px rgba(25,227,200,.06);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.player::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid transparent;pointer-events:none}
.player-art{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;background:var(--raise)}
.player-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:kb 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes kb{from{transform:scale(1.02) translate(0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.14) translate(-2%,-3%)}}
.player-badge{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:rgba(8,3,20,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);padding:5px 9px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal)}
.player-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;margin-top:16px}
.player h3{font-size:1.4rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.player .by{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin-top:3px}
.eq{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2.5px;height:26px}
.eq i{width:3px;height:100%;background:var(--teal);border-radius:1px;transform-origin:bottom;transform:scaleY(.25);animation:eqb .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.eq i:nth-child(2){background:var(--violet);animation-duration:.65s}
.eq i:nth-child(3){animation-duration:1.1s}
.eq i:nth-child(4){background:var(--violet);animation-duration:.78s}
.eq i:nth-child(5){animation-duration:.95s}
@keyframes eqb{to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.paused .eq i,.paused .player-art img{animation-play-state:paused}
.paused .eq i{transform:scaleY(.14)}
.scrub{margin-top:18px}
.scrub-bars{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;height:30px}
.scrub-bars i{flex:1;background:var(--muted2);border-radius:1px;transition:background .3s,height .3s}
.scrub-bars i.on{background:var(--teal)}
.scrub-times{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--muted2);margin-top:7px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.play-btn{flex:none;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cream);color:var(--void);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),background .3s}
.play-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.08);background:var(--teal)}
.play-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.player{max-width:420px}}

/* waveform canvas */
#scope{display:block;width:100%;height:150px;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:-6px}

/* ============ SECTION SHELL ============ */
section{position:relative}
.sec{padding:clamp(70px,9vw,130px) 0}
.sec-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:46px}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.5rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:20ch}
.sec-idx{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px}
.sec-idx::before{content:'';width:7px;height:7px;border:1px solid var(--teal);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.sec-head p{color:var(--muted);max-width:38ch;font-size:.95rem;margin:0}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.eq-divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;height:26px;overflow:hidden;opacity:.5}
.eq-divider i{flex:1;background:var(--violet-dim);min-width:2px}

/* ============ ARTIST RAIL ============ */
.rail-sec{background:var(--plum);border-block:1px solid var(--edge)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);border-radius:2px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.63rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);transition:.28s}
.chip:hover{color:var(--cream);border-color:var(--teal)}
.chip.on{background:var(--teal);border-color:var(--teal);color:#05130f}
.rail{display:flex;gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding:6px 0 26px;scrollbar-width:none;cursor:grab}
.rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.rail.drag{cursor:grabbing}
.vinyl{position:relative;flex:0 0 236px;scroll-snap-align:start;background:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--edge);padding:11px 11px 15px;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .45s,opacity .4s}
.vinyl:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:var(--edge-strong)}
.vinyl.hide{opacity:0;transform:scale(.94);pointer-events:none;width:0;flex-basis:0;padding:0;margin:0;overflow:hidden;border:0}
.vinyl-art{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;background:var(--void)}
.vinyl-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);filter:saturate(.85)}
.vinyl:hover .vinyl-art img{transform:scale(1.09);filter:saturate(1.1)}
.disc{position:absolute;top:8%;right:-46%;width:84%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#241038 0 22%,#0d0618 23% 24%,#1a0d2b 25% 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(160,120,220,.25) inset,0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.6);transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.disc::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:38%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal)}
.vinyl:hover .disc{transform:translateX(38%)}
.vinyl h4{font-size:1.05rem;margin-top:13px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.vinyl .vmeta{color:var(--muted2);font-size:.75rem;font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:5px}
.vinyl .vtag{position:absolute;top:18px;left:0;background:var(--violet);color:#fff;padding:3px 8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vinyl .vtag.hot{background:var(--teal);color:#05130f}

/* ============ FEATURES (sticky two-col) ============ */
.feat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:clamp(30px,5vw,80px);align-items:start}
.feat-sticky{position:sticky;top:120px}
.feat-sticky h2{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.2vw,3.4rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.feat-sticky p{color:var(--muted);margin:22px 0 26px;max-width:34ch}
.pct{border:1px solid var(--edge);padding:18px;background:var(--plum)}
.pct-bar{height:8px;background:var(--raise);display:flex;overflow:hidden;margin:12px 0 10px}
.pct-bar i{background:var(--teal)}
.pct-bar i:nth-child(2){background:var(--violet)}
.pct-bar i:nth-child(3){background:var(--muted2)}
.pct-legend{display:flex;gap:16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--muted2);letter-spacing:.1em;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pct-legend b{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;margin-right:6px}
.feat-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:22px;padding:30px 24px;border:1px solid transparent;border-bottom-color:var(--edge);transition:.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);position:relative}
.feat:hover{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--raise),transparent);border-color:var(--edge-strong);padding-left:34px}
.feat .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--teal);letter-spacing:.12em;padding-top:6px}
.feat h3{font-size:1.45rem;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-bottom:10px}
.feat p{color:var(--muted);margin:0;font-size:.94rem;max-width:52ch}
.feat .kv{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.feat .kv span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2);border:1px solid var(--edge);padding:4px 9px}
.feat:hover .kv span{border-color:var(--edge-strong);color:var(--cream)}
@media(max-width:900px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.feat-sticky{position:static}}

/* ============ SESSION TAPES (stacked cards) ============ */
.tapes{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--void),var(--deep))}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px}
.tape{position:sticky;top:110px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);background:var(--plum);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 -10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.tape:nth-child(2){top:128px;background:var(--raise)}
.tape:nth-child(3){top:146px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--raise2),var(--plum))}
.tape:nth-child(4){top:164px;background:var(--deep)}
.tape-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:290px}
.tape-img img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:kb 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.tape-img .lbl{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:14px;background:rgba(8,3,20,.72);padding:6px 10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);border:1px solid var(--edge-strong)}
.tape-body{padding:clamp(24px,3vw,42px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.tape-body .ep{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--violet);text-transform:uppercase}
.tape-body h3{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.6vw,2.3rem);margin:14px 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.tape-body p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px;max-width:48ch;font-size:.95rem}
.tracklist{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;color:var(--muted2);letter-spacing:.06em;border-top:1px solid var(--edge);padding-top:16px}
.tracklist b{color:var(--cream);font-weight:400}
@media(max-width:820px){.tape{grid-template-columns:1fr;position:static}.tape-img{min-height:220px}}

/* ============ CHART ============ */
.chart-sec{background:var(--plum);border-block:1px solid var(--edge)}
.chart-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .65fr;gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,48px);align-items:start}
.rows{border-top:1px solid var(--edge)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 52px 1fr 130px 52px;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:14px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);position:relative;transition:background .3s,transform .3s;cursor:pointer}
.row::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--teal);transform:scaleY(0);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.row:hover,.row.sel{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(139,92,246,.16),transparent)}
.row:hover::before,.row.sel::before{transform:scaleY(1)}
.row .rk{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--muted2);letter-spacing:-.04em}
.row.sel .rk,.row:hover .rk{color:var(--teal)}
.row .thumb{width:52px;height:52px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--raise)}
.row .thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.row .ttl{font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.row .art{color:var(--muted2);font-size:.8rem}
.row .dur{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted2);text-align:right}
.spark{height:26px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px}
.spark i{flex:1;background:var(--violet-dim);transition:height .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background .3s}
.row:hover .spark i{background:var(--teal)}
.now-panel{position:sticky;top:120px;border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--raise2),var(--void));padding:16px}
.now-panel .np-art{aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.now-panel .np-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:opacity .4s}
.np-body{padding:16px 4px 4px}
.np-body .mono{color:var(--teal)}
.np-body h3{font-size:1.5rem;margin:10px 0 4px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.np-body .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.np-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--edge);margin-top:18px;border:1px solid var(--edge)}
.np-stats div{background:var(--void);padding:11px 12px}
.np-stats strong{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.np-stats span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2)}
.fade{animation:fade .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
@media(max-width:900px){.chart-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.row{grid-template-columns:34px 44px 1fr 52px}.row .spark{display:none}.now-panel{position:static}}

/* ============ STATS BAND ============ */
.band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--edge);border-block:1px solid var(--edge)}
.band div{background:var(--deep);padding:clamp(26px,3.4vw,44px) clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px);transition:background .4s}
.band div:hover{background:var(--raise)}
.band strong{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.2vw,3.2rem);letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1}
.band strong .u{color:var(--teal);font-size:.55em}
.band p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--muted2);font-size:.82rem;max-width:22ch}
@media(max-width:820px){.band{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* ============ POSTCARDS ============ */
.cards{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(18px,2.6vw,34px)}
.card{background:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);padding:26px 24px 22px;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .55s,border-color .4s;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.9)}
.card:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(-1.6deg)}
.card:nth-child(2){transform:rotate(.9deg) translateY(22px)}
.card:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-.6deg) translateY(-10px)}
.card:hover{transform:rotate(0) translateY(-8px) scale(1.015);border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 34px 70px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.95)}
.card q{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:1.18rem;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.02em;quotes:'“' '”'}
.card .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge)}
.card .who img{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.card .who b{display:block;font-size:.9rem}
.card .who span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2)}
.card .stamp{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
@media(max-width:820px){.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card,.card:nth-child(n){transform:none}}

/* ============ PRICING ============ */
.price-head{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:44px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.switch{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);padding:3px;gap:2px}
.switch button{padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);transition:.3s}
.switch button.on{background:var(--teal);color:#05130f}
.save{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal)}
.tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.22fr 1fr;gap:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);align-items:center}
.tier{border:1px solid var(--edge);padding:30px 26px;background:var(--plum);transition:.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.tier:hover{border-color:var(--edge-strong);transform:translateY(-6px)}
.tier h3{font-size:1.35rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.tier .tagline{color:var(--muted2);font-size:.82rem;margin:6px 0 20px}
.tier .amt{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4vw,3.4rem);letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1}
.tier .amt sup{font-size:.36em;vertical-align:super;font-weight:600;margin-right:2px}
.tier .per{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2);margin-top:8px}
.tier ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:22px 0 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.tier li{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.tier li::before{content:'';flex:none;width:6px;height:6px;margin-top:8px;background:var(--violet);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.tier.feature{background:linear-gradient(165deg,var(--raise2),var(--void));border-color:var(--teal);padding:44px 32px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 40px 90px -40px rgba(25,227,200,.3)}
.tier.feature::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--violet),var(--teal))}
.tier.feature li::before{background:var(--teal)}
.tier .flag{position:absolute;top:-13px;left:32px;background:var(--teal);color:#05130f;padding:4px 10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500}
@media(max-width:900px){.tiers{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============ CTA ============ */
.cta{position:relative;background:radial-gradient(760px 340px at 50% 110%,rgba(139,92,246,.34),transparent 70%),var(--deep);border-top:1px solid var(--edge);overflow:hidden}
.cta #scope2{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;width:100%;height:130px;opacity:.75}
.cta-in{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding-block:clamp(80px,10vw,140px)}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,7vw,5.6rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:.92;max-width:16ch;margin:20px auto 0}
.cta p{color:var(--muted);max-width:46ch;margin:22px auto 34px}
form.join{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}
form.join input{flex:1 1 240px;background:rgba(8,3,20,.7);border:1px solid var(--edge-strong);color:var(--cream);padding:14px 16px;font-family:var(--body);font-size:.92rem;transition:.3s}
form.join input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(25,227,200,.14)}
form.join input::placeholder{color:var(--muted2)}
.msg{min-height:22px;margin-top:14px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.msg.ok{color:var(--teal)}.msg.bad{color:#ff7b9c}
.shrines{display:flex;gap:26px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2)}
.shrines a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
.shrines a:hover{color:var(--teal)}

/* ============ FOOTER ============ */
footer{background:var(--void);border-top:1px solid var(--edge);padding:clamp(50px,6vw,80px) 0 30px}
.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr repeat(4,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,3vw,44px)}
footer h5{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:500}
footer ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
footer li a{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;transition:color .3s,padding-left .3s}
footer li a:hover{color:var(--cream);padding-left:5px}
.f-blurb{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;max-width:34ch;margin:16px 0 0}
.f-bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px);padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2)}
.f-bot a{color:var(--muted2)}.f-bot a:hover{color:var(--teal)}
@media(max-width:900px){.f-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* ============ REDUCED MOTION ============ */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .mask>span{transform:none}
  .tape{position:static}
  .ticker-track{animation:none}
}
</style>
</head>

<!-- ============ FEATURES ============ -->
<section class="sec" id="why">
  <div class="wrap feat-grid">
    <aside class="feat-sticky reveal">
      <p class="sec-idx">02 / Architecture</p>
      <h2>Built like a label,<br>not a vault</h2>
      <p>Most platforms treat music as free labour. Wavefront was engineered the other way round: the payout ledger is the product, and everything else is interface.</p>
      <div class="pct">
        <div class="mono" style="color:var(--muted2)">Where £1 of your subscription goes</div>
        <div class="pct-bar"><i style="width:72%"></i><i style="width:16%"></i><i style="width:12%"></i></div>
        <div class="pct-legend"><span><b style="background:var(--teal)"></b>Artists 72%</span><span><b style="background:var(--violet)"></b>Infra 16%</span><span><b style="background:var(--muted2)"></b>Co-op 12%</b></span></div>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <div class="feat-list">
      <article class="feat reveal"><span class="n">01</span><div>
        <h3>Per-listen micro-payouts</h3>
        <p>Play clears a royalty the second it's streamed — no quarterly black box, no recoupment maze, no minimum threshold to cash out. Artists see each penny with a timestamp.</p>
        <div class="kv"><span>Instant ledger</span><span>No floor</span><span>Transparent rate</span></div>
      </div></article>
      <article class="feat reveal" data-delay="60"><span class="n">02</span><div>
        <h3>Liner notes, restored</h3>
        <p>Every release ships with credits, gear lists, the room it was tracked in, and the story in the artist's own words. Scroll a track and read the record, not just the metadata.</p>
        <div class="kv"><span>Credits</span><span>Gear</span><span>Notes</span></div>
      </div></article>
      <article class="feat reveal" data-delay="120"><span class="n">03</span><div>
        <h3>Human-first radio</h3>
        <p>Wavefront Sessions are hosted by the artists themselves — 90 minutes of their own shelf, influences and unreleased sketches. No algorithm pretending to be a DJ.</p>
        <div class="kv"><span>Live Thu 20:00</span><span>Hosted by artists</span><span>Archive</span></div>
      </div></article>
      <article class="feat reveal" data-delay="180"><span class="n">04</span><div>
        <h3>Lossless for everyone</h3>
        <p>24-bit / 96kHz FLAC on the free tier and the paid ones. Offline caches, gapless mixes, and a mastering-accurate profile curve so a tape sounds like the tape.</p>
        <div class="kv"><span>24-bit FLAC</span><span>Gapless</span><span>Dolby-free</span></div>
      </div></article>
      <article class="feat reveal" data-delay="240"><span class="n">05</span><div>
        <h3>Scene Maps</h3>
        <p>See what's releasing, rehearsing and playing within 5km of you. Opt-in, city-scale, and built with venues — the local record shop finally has a homepage.</p>
        <div class="kv"><span>5km radius</span><span>Gig listings</span><span>Venue-owned</span></div>
      </div></article>
      <article class="feat reveal" data-delay="300"><span class="n">06</span><div>
        <h3>No ads. No data brokers.</h3>
        <p>Subscriptions and artist tip jars fund the whole thing. Your listening history stays on your device, encrypted, and is never sold, modelled or matched.</p>
        <div class="kv"><span>Zero trackers</span><span>On-device</span><span>Audited yearly</span></div>
      </div></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

          <h3>Patch notes for cold weather</h3>

          <div class="tracklist"><span><b>A1</b> Frostbite Logic</span><span><b>A2</b> Permafrost (raw)</span><span><b>B1</b> One Take North</span><span><b>B3</b> Tape Loop Study</span></div>
        </div>
      </article>
      <article class="tape">
        <div class="tape-img"><img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/session-tape-choir-hall/900/700" alt="Choir singing in a hall"><span class="lbl">EP 44 · 76 min</span></div>

  </div>
  <div style="height:clamp(46px,6vw,80px)"></div>
  <div class="wrap"><div class="band reveal">
    <div><strong data-count="84200">0</strong><p>independent artists with owned masters</p></div>
